The findings, interpretations, and conclusions expressed in this paper are entirely those of the authors and should not be attributed in any manner to the World Bank, to its affiliated organizations, or to members of its Board of Executive Directors or the countries they represent.

detail.abstract: Many policy decisions involve trade-offs between lives and livelihoods. We provide the first estimates for a new welfare parameter that expresses this trade-off in the longevity-poverty space. To do so, we conduct randomized survey experiments with 20,000 respondents across seven middle-and high-income countries. Both the median and mean responses imply that individuals are willing to spend no more than about two years in poverty to gain one additional year of life, sharply restricting the plausible range for this normative parameter. We show how these estimates can inform policy trade-offs related to long-run global development, pandemic responses, and climate change.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过调查实验首次量化了人们在寿命与贫困之间的权衡偏好，发现个体平均愿意用不超过约2年贫困换取1年额外寿命，为政策决策提供了新的福利参数。
AI.research_question: 人们在寿命延长与贫困风险之间如何进行权衡？具体来说，个体愿意承受多少年的贫困来换取一年的额外寿命？
AI.motivation: 许多政策决策（如全球发展、疫情应对、气候变化）都涉及生命与生计之间的权衡，但缺乏量化这种权衡的福利参数，需要实证研究来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 福利经济学中的权衡理论，特别是在寿命-贫困空间中的偏好权衡框架，为量化政策决策中的生命与生计交换提供理论基础。
AI.method: 在7个中高收入国家对20,000名受访者进行随机调查实验，测量个体在寿命延长与贫困风险之间的权衡偏好。
AI.findings: 中位数和平均数都显示，个体愿意用不超过约2年的贫困来换取1年的额外寿命，这一结果显著限制了该规范性参数的合理范围。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出了量化寿命-贫困权衡的福利参数，为福利经济学和政策分析提供了新的实证基础，丰富了政策权衡的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果为全球发展政策、疫情应对措施和气候变化政策的制定提供了具体的权衡参数，帮助决策者在生命与生计之间做出更科学的权衡。

reference: Colonial Continuities, Global Shifts, and Digital Transformations in IPR
title: Colonial Genealogies of Marks and the Making of India’s Craft Identities: The Start of a Dialogue
affiliations: Queens University Belfast

detail.title: Colonial Genealogies of Marks and the Making of India’s Craft Identities: The Start of a Dialogue

publicationDetails.detailsText: Colonial Continuities, Global Shifts, and Digital Transformations in IPR

detail.abstract:
This chapter looks at collective and certification trademarks through the lens of India’s craft economy, asking what happens when a legal system built around individual ownership and formal markets is applied to deeply collective, informal ways of producing the final product of value. While trademarks are often imagined in terms of logos and brands, craft production presents a very different picture. The following chapter attempts to trace how this mismatch emerged historically, beginning with colonial trademark law, which prioritised imperial trade and merchant goodwill while leaving collective craft production legally undervalued. It then turns to the post-independence period, where crafts were governed largely through state-led institutions, certification schemes, and development policy, with trademark law arriving late and unevenly as a tool for collective identity.

Drawing on examples from textiles, pottery, and metal crafts, the chapter argues that collective and certification marks today operate more as socio-legal infrastructures. They organise membership, define authenticity, distribute authority, and shape who becomes visible in markets. While these marks can offer real benefits ranging from visibility to increased bargaining power, they can also reproduce internal hierarchies and discipline craft practices in subtle ways. The chapter ultimately argues that the key issue is not the existence of collective marks themselves, but the way they are governed, and whether trademark law has the space to genuinely treat collective labour and community authority as foundational principles.

AI.tldr: 该章节探讨了在印度手工艺经济中，集体商标和认证商标如何运作。研究发现，当围绕个人所有权和正式市场建立的法律体系应用于集体性、非正式的生产方式时，商标法更多地成为社会法律基础设施，组织成员资格、定义真实性、分配权威，并塑造市场中的可见性。
AI.research_question: 当围绕个人所有权和正式市场建立的法律体系应用于集体性、非正式的手工艺生产方式时，集体商标和认证商标会如何运作？
AI.motivation: 商标法通常围绕个人所有权和正式市场设计，但手工艺生产具有集体性和非正式性，这种不匹配需要研究。了解商标法如何影响集体手工艺生产，以及如何更好地保护集体劳动和社区权威。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 商标法理论（个人所有权与集体生产的冲突）
2. 社会法律基础设施理论
3. 后殖民法律研究
4. 发展政策与制度理论
AI.method:
历史分析法（追溯从殖民时期到后独立时期的演变）
案例研究法（纺织品、陶器、金属手工艺等实例）
法律文本分析
制度分析
AI.findings:
1. 殖民时期的商标法优先考虑帝国贸易和商人商誉，而集体手工艺生产在法律上被低估
2. 后独立时期，手工艺主要通过国家主导的机构、认证计划和发展政策管理，商标法作为集体身份工具出现较晚且不均衡
3. 集体和认证商标现在更多地作为社会法律基础设施运作：组织成员资格、定义真实性、分配权威、塑造市场可见性
4. 这些商标能带来实际利益（可见性、议价能力），但也可能复制内部等级制度并以微妙方式规范手工艺实践
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 扩展了商标法理论，将其应用于集体和非正式生产环境
2. 提出了"社会法律基础设施"概念，解释商标在集体生产中的多重功能
3. 为后殖民法律研究提供了印度手工艺经济的实证案例
4. 挑战了商标法以个人所有权为中心的传统假设
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供了改进集体商标治理的建议
2. 帮助手工艺社区更好地理解和利用商标保护
3. 指出了现有商标法在保护集体劳动和社区权威方面的局限性
4. 为发展机构和认证机构提供了实践指导

title: Returning the Land: Toward a Species-First Framework for Nature-Based Solutions Design

detail.title: Returning the Land: Toward a Species-First Framework for Nature-Based Solutions Design

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a conceptual and analytical paper. It does not involve human subjects, animal experimentation, or primary data collection requiring institutional ethical review. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All work was conducted independently under ENHANCE Institute.

detail.abstract:
The decline of pollinators is commonly framed as a biodiversity crisis. This paper argues that it is more fundamentally a crisis of dispossession. Human land conversion has not merely degraded ecosystems; it has systematically displaced non-human species from the habitats in which they evolved. Yet contemporary Nature-based Solutions (NbS) continue to treat these species as if they can be reintroduced into landscapes defined by human objectives.

This paper identifies a structural flaw in prevailing NbS design: a human-first sequence, in which climate targets, funding constraints, and land availability are determined prior to ecological viability. Species are subsequently expected to occupy these predefined spaces, despite the absence of suitable habitat conditions.

In response, this study proposes the Species-First Framework (SFF), which reverses the design sequence. Rather than asking where humans wish to restore nature, the framework begins by identifying where displaced species can viably exist. It argues that effective ecological recovery depends not on the artificial placement of species, but on the return of habitat within landscapes that humans have neglected or abandoned for productive use.

The framework is operationalized through Elōra-X™, a wildflower-based restoration system applied to degraded coastal marine terraces in western Madagascar. These geomorphologically marginal terrains, largely unsuitable for agriculture or settlement expansion, are reinterpreted as viable habitats for native wildflowers and pollinator communities. By embedding livelihood generation within ecological function through apiculture, seed-based value chains, and community stewardship, the system reduces reliance on external incentives and supports long-term persistence. Its causal structure is formalized using ToC:f(x)™, enabling function-based verification of ecological and socio-economic outcomes.

This paper argues that Nature-based Solutions should not begin with the question of where humans intend to intervene, but with where non-human life can still belong. In this sense, restoration is not the construction of ecosystems, but the structured return of habitat to the species from which it was taken.

AI.tldr: 本文批判当前基于自然的解决方案(NbS)以人类优先的设计顺序，提出物种优先框架(SFF)，主张生态恢复应从识别物种可生存的栖息地开始，而非将物种安置在人类预先定义的空间中。通过马达加斯加海岸海洋阶地的野花恢复系统案例，展示了如何将生计与生态功能结合实现长期可持续性。
AI.research_question: 如何重新设计基于自然的解决方案(NbS)以解决授粉者减少的根本问题——栖息地剥夺，而非仅仅作为生物多样性危机？
AI.motivation: 授粉者减少通常被框架为生物多样性危机，但本文认为这本质上是栖息地剥夺危机。当前NbS以人类优先的顺序设计，先确定气候目标、资金约束和土地可用性，然后期望物种适应这些预定义空间，忽视了物种的实际栖息地需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 栖息地剥夺理论：授粉者减少的根本原因是人类土地转换导致的栖息地系统性剥夺；2) 物种优先框架(SFF)：逆转传统NbS设计顺序，从识别物种可生存的栖息地开始；3) 生态恢复作为栖息地归还：恢复不是生态系统构建，而是将栖息地归还给被剥夺的物种。
AI.method: 1) 理论框架构建：提出物种优先框架(SFF)；2) 案例研究：在马达加斯加西部退化海岸海洋阶地应用Elōra-X™野花恢复系统；3) 因果结构形式化：使用ToC:f(x)™进行功能验证；4) 生计-生态整合：通过养蜂、种子价值链和社区管理将生计生成嵌入生态功能。
AI.findings: 1) 人类忽视或废弃的边缘地形(如海岸海洋阶地)可作为本地野花和授粉者群落的可行栖息地；2) 通过将生计生成(养蜂、种子价值链)嵌入生态功能，可减少对外部激励的依赖并支持长期持续性；3) 物种优先方法比传统人类优先方法更有效地实现生态恢复。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将授粉者减少重新概念化为栖息地剥夺危机而非生物多样性危机；2) 提出物种优先框架(SFF)作为NbS设计的替代范式；3) 建立生态恢复作为栖息地归还的理论基础；4) 为功能验证提供ToC:f(x)™形式化方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供Elōra-X™野花恢复系统的可操作框架；2) 展示如何在边缘地形实施物种优先恢复；3) 提供生计-生态整合模型(养蜂、种子价值链)；4) 为社区管理提供可持续性机制；5) 为政策制定者提供替代NbS设计方法。

title: Structural Determinism in Climate Project Architecture: A Set-Theoretic and Invertibility-Based Foundation

detail.title: Structural Determinism in Climate Project Architecture: A Set-Theoretic and Invertibility-Based Foundation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental subjects. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
The accelerating climate crisis exposes a fundamental limitation in contemporary climate project evaluation: most frameworks rely on probabilistic causality (P→Q), assuming that interventions may lead to desired outcomes. Under finite temporal and financial constraints, such probabilistic architectures are insufficient to ensure physically verifiable climate results.

This paper introduces a structural determinism framework grounded in set theory and inverse functional logic. A valid climate project is defined not by narrative alignment or expected correlation, but by structural inclusion: the intervention set P must be fully contained within the domain of legitimate physical climate outcomes Q, formally expressed as P ⊆ Q (equivalently, P − Q = ∅). Here, Q is defined as the intersection of climate-induced physical hazards (C) and directly affected human survival systems (H), i.e., Q = C ∩ H.

Within this formulation, project integrity is evaluated through structural purity, defined as |P ∩ Q| / |P|, which quantifies the proportion of project actions causally aligned with physical climate mitigation or adaptation. The framework further establishes invertibility (existence of f⁻¹) as a necessary condition for causal attribution and accountability, and formalizes structural drift as an entropic degradation of alignment over time.

By reframing climate impact as a set-theoretic and functional property rather than a probabilistic projection, this study advances a deterministic architecture for distinguishing structurally valid climate interventions from domain violations. The resulting framework provides a mathematical foundation for evaluating climate project legitimacy under finite time and capital constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于集合论和逆函数逻辑的结构确定性框架，重新定义气候项目评估标准：从概率因果转向结构包含，要求干预集P必须完全包含在物理气候结果Q中，通过结构纯度量化项目行动与气候缓解/适应的因果对齐程度。
AI.research_question: 在有限时间和资金约束下，如何建立确定性的气候项目评估框架，确保物理可验证的气候结果？
AI.motivation: 当前气候项目评估大多依赖概率因果关系，假设干预可能导致期望结果。在加速的气候危机和有限资源约束下，这种概率架构不足以确保物理可验证的气候结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于集合论和逆函数逻辑的结构确定性框架。定义有效气候项目为结构包含关系：干预集P必须完全包含在物理气候结果Q中（P ⊆ Q），其中Q定义为气候引发的物理危害(C)与直接影响的人类生存系统(H)的交集（Q = C ∩ H）。
AI.method: 引入结构纯度指标（|P ∩ Q| / |P|）量化项目行动与气候缓解/适应的因果对齐程度。建立可逆性（存在f⁻¹）作为因果归因和问责的必要条件。形式化结构漂移作为随时间对齐度的熵减退化。
AI.findings: 通过将气候影响重新定义为集合论和函数属性而非概率预测，建立了区分结构有效气候干预与领域违规的确定性架构。该框架为有限时间和资本约束下的气候项目合法性评估提供了数学基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出结构确定性框架，从概率因果转向结构包含；2. 引入结构纯度量化指标；3. 建立可逆性作为因果归因的必要条件；4. 形式化结构漂移概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为气候项目评估提供确定性数学框架，帮助决策者在有限资源下区分有效干预与无效项目，提高气候投资效率和问责性。

title: From Product to Practice: Geographical Indications and Productive Capacities in Traditional Textiles
affiliations: Queens University Belfast

detail.title: From Product to Practice: Geographical Indications and Productive Capacities in Traditional Textiles
detail.abstract: Geographical Indications (GIs) are often presented as the "best fit" IP tool for traditional textiles because they protect collective reputation and link products to place. Yet, in many textile contexts, GI protection delivers recognition without securing the conditions that make production possible. Names and reputations are protected, but the labour, skills, and social systems that sustain weaving, dyeing, printing, and other techniques remain economically and institutionally fragile. This paper argues that this gap is best understood by shifting the evaluative lens from products to productive capacities. Drawing on Cwik's productive capacities view, it treats cultural ownership as the ability of producer communities to sustain skilled labour, transmit knowledge across generations, organise collectively, and engage markets on fair, non-extractive terms. The article shows how product-centred specifications, authorised-user systems, and compliance-oriented control bodies can generate "visibility without empowerment," including through value capture by intermediaries. It then develops a practical agenda for reorienting GI governance using existing tools to move from fragile recognition to durable, people-centred ownership that supports living textile traditions over time.

AI.tldr: 本文认为地理标志(GI)保护在纺织品领域存在"认可但不赋能"的缺陷，主张从产品导向转向生产能力导向，重新设计GI治理以支持可持续的纺织传统。
AI.research_question: 为什么地理标志(GI)保护在纺织品领域经常只提供认可而未能确保生产能力？如何重新设计GI治理以支持可持续的纺织传统？
AI.motivation: 地理标志常被视为传统纺织品的最佳知识产权工具，但在实践中往往只保护名称和声誉，未能保护维持生产所需的劳动、技能和社会系统，导致生产能力脆弱。
AI.theoretical_framework: Cwik的生产能力视角，将文化所有权定义为生产者社区维持熟练劳动、跨代传承知识、集体组织和公平参与市场的能力。
AI.method: 概念分析框架，通过批判性分析现有GI保护机制（产品规格、授权用户系统、合规控制机构）的局限性。
AI.findings: 现有GI保护机制产生"可见但不赋能"的现象，包括中间商的价值攫取；产品导向的规范未能保护生产能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 从产品导向到生产能力导向的理论转向，为理解GI保护的局限性提供了新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了重新定位GI治理的实践议程，利用现有工具从脆弱认可转向持久、以人为本的所有权，支持活态纺织传统。

title: Generative AI, Online Self-Presentation, and Labor Market Signaling: Evidence from LinkedIn Posting Behavior
affiliations: and Other Firms

detail.title: Generative AI, Online Self-Presentation, and Labor Market Signaling: Evidence from LinkedIn Posting Behavior
detail.abstract: We examine how the emergence of generative AI tools is associated with changes in LinkedIn employee posting behavior between 2019 and 2025. Using a novel dataset of daily LinkedIn posts by individual users worldwide, we document sharp increases in posting activity following major generative AI releases-notably OpenAI's public release of ChatGPT on November 30, 2022-and sustained growth through subsequent releases (GPT-4 in early 2023, Google's Gemini in late 2023, OpenAI's GPT-4o in mid-2024, and OpenAI o1 in late 2024). Descriptive evidence indicates an order-of-magnitude increase in average posts per employee over the sample period. To assess how communication content evolves, we analyze posts from a random sample of employees at two large technology firms, Apple and Microsoft, using natural language processing methods. We find that while basic length measures (words, tokens, and sentences) follow gradual upward trends that predate the AI shock, features related to structure, formatting, and style exhibit sharper post-2022 shifts. In particular, posts become more segmented, organized, and expressive, with substantial increases in paragraph breaks, bullet-point usage, and emoji use; lexical diversity increases more modestly and mainly during later diffusion waves. Regression estimates show that these post-2022 patterns persist after controlling for individual characteristics, job roles, departments, seniority, company affiliation, and time effects. Overall, the results suggest that generative AI has reduced the cost of professional self-presentation and altered the form and style of online labor market signaling. While these changes may broaden visibility and communication confidence, they also raise concerns about the informational content of professional signals. We conclude with implications for labor market signaling and directions for future research on the causal and distributional effects of AI-assisted communication.

AI.tldr: 生成式AI工具的出现与LinkedIn员工发帖行为显著变化相关，特别是ChatGPT发布后发帖量大幅增加，帖子结构、格式和风格发生明显变化，降低了专业自我展示成本，改变了在线劳动力市场信号的形式和风格。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI工具的出现如何影响LinkedIn员工的发帖行为？具体来说，AI工具如何改变发帖频率、内容结构、格式和风格？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI工具的快速发展可能改变在线专业沟通方式，但缺乏实证证据表明这些工具如何影响员工在LinkedIn等专业平台上的自我展示行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场信号理论：员工通过在线平台展示专业能力；成本降低理论：AI降低了专业自我展示的成本；技术扩散理论：新技术如何随时间影响行为。
AI.method: 使用2019-2025年全球LinkedIn用户每日发帖的新数据集，分析主要AI发布事件前后的发帖活动变化。对苹果和微软员工的随机样本进行自然语言处理分析，控制个体特征、职位、部门、资历、公司归属和时间效应。
AI.findings: 1. ChatGPT等主要AI发布后发帖量大幅增加，样本期间平均发帖量增长一个数量级；2. 帖子结构、格式和风格发生显著变化：更多分段、项目符号和表情符号使用，帖子更结构化、有组织性和表达性；3. 词汇多样性增加较温和，主要在后期扩散阶段；4. 这些变化在控制多种因素后仍然显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为AI如何改变在线专业沟通提供实证证据；2. 扩展劳动力市场信号理论，考虑AI辅助沟通的影响；3. 展示技术扩散如何具体影响专业自我展示行为。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助企业和员工理解AI如何改变专业沟通；2. 提醒关注AI辅助沟通可能降低专业信号的信息含量；3. 为平台设计者提供改进建议；4. 为政策制定者考虑AI对劳动力市场的影响提供依据。

title: Altruism, Mutually Assured Temptation, and Preferences over Prisoner's Dilemmas
affiliations: Economics Department, University of Bath and Loyola University Maryland

detail.title: Altruism, Mutually Assured Temptation, and Preferences over Prisoner's Dilemmas
detail.abstract: Material payoffs tempt altruistic decision makers in isolation to sacrifice their virtuous commitments towards the society. Accordingly, they wish to ex-ante avoid more tempting decision-making environments in a two-stage framework where they first choose an environment and then an action within it. However, the notions of virtue and vice at the group level are philosophically problematic to define or predict. To address these issues, we extend the analysis to strategic settings where instead of decision-making environments, altruistic individuals first choose between prisoner's dilemma games with more or less tempting material payoffs and then play the game. Our focus on Prisoner's dilemma games is because these are classic models of social situations where both altruism and temptation co-exist naturally. We find that, in contrast to isolated decision makers who always fall for temptation and hence may avoid more tempting environments if given a choice, games with higher temptation can enhance cooperation among altruistic players. This curious possibility in the second stage implies that, in the first stage, a group of non-cooperative players may prefer prisoner's dilemma games with higher temptation as they agree, counterintuitively, that greed can enhance cooperation towards achieving their altruistic goals. We then show that material and psychological payoffs are aligned in equilibrium, so both materialist planners and decentralized altruistic agents may rationally select, ex-ante, more tempting games to better achieve both materialistic and altruistic ends.

AI.tldr: 在战略环境中，利他主义个体可能选择更具诱惑力的囚徒困境游戏，因为更高的物质诱惑反而能促进合作，这与孤立决策者总是屈服于诱惑的直觉相反。
AI.research_question: 利他主义个体在战略环境中如何选择决策环境（囚徒困境游戏），以及这种选择如何影响合作行为？
AI.motivation: 在孤立决策中，物质诱惑会使利他主义决策者违背对社会的道德承诺，因此他们希望避免更具诱惑的环境。但在群体层面定义美德与恶习存在哲学难题，需要研究战略环境中的选择行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于囚徒困境游戏理论，结合利他主义与诱惑的共存性，分析战略环境选择对合作行为的影响。
AI.method: 采用两阶段分析框架：第一阶段个体选择不同诱惑程度的囚徒困境游戏，第二阶段在选定游戏中行动。通过理论模型分析均衡结果。
AI.findings: 与孤立决策者总是屈服于诱惑不同，在战略环境中，更高的诱惑反而能促进利他主义玩家之间的合作。非合作玩家可能选择更具诱惑的游戏，因为贪婪能增强合作以实现利他目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了诱惑环境选择理论到战略情境，揭示了诱惑与合作的非单调关系，挑战了"诱惑总是破坏合作"的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制度设计者提供启示：在某些情况下，设计更具诱惑的激励机制反而能促进合作，实现物质与心理收益的均衡。

title: The Ontological Relationship Between the Knowledge Economy and the Techno-Feudal Order: A Story of Usurpation, Not Continuity

detail.title: The Ontological Relationship Between the Knowledge Economy and the Techno-Feudal Order: A Story of Usurpation, Not Continuity
detail.abstract: This paper explores the ontological disconnect between the traditional "Knowledge Economy" and the emerging "Techno-feudal" order. It argues that the transition between these two regimes does not constitute a linear evolution or digital progress, but rather a structural usurpation. While the knowledge economy posits the human being as an epistemic subject and the generator of value through intellect, the techno-feudal order reduces the human to a passive source of behavioral data. The paper identifies the "knowledge economy" discourse as a contemporary veil of legitimacy-a dual-layered ontological fraud-that masks the systemic liquidation of human agency. Furthermore, it critiques the role of progressive and humanist actors who, by focusing on superficial ethical regulations, inadvertently provide consent to this epistemic displacement.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了传统"知识经济"与新兴"技术封建"秩序之间的本体论断裂，认为这种转变并非线性进化或数字进步，而是结构性篡夺。知识经济将人视为认知主体和价值创造者，而技术封建秩序则将人降级为被动行为数据源。论文批判知识经济话语作为合法性面纱，掩盖了人类能动性的系统性清算。
AI.research_question: 传统"知识经济"与新兴"技术封建"秩序之间的本体论断裂是什么？这种转变如何构成结构性篡夺而非线性进化？知识经济话语如何作为合法性面纱掩盖人类能动性的系统性清算？
AI.motivation: 当前数字转型常被描述为知识经济的自然演进，但作者认为这掩盖了更深层的结构性变化。需要揭示知识经济话语如何作为合法性面纱，掩盖从人类作为认知主体到被动数据源的转变，以及这种转变对人类能动性的侵蚀。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本体论断裂理论、技术封建主义理论、知识经济批判理论、人类能动性理论、合法性话语分析框架
AI.method: 概念分析、话语分析、批判理论分析、本体论比较分析
AI.findings: 1. 知识经济与技术封建秩序之间存在根本的本体论断裂；2. 这种转变是结构性篡夺而非线性进化；3. 知识经济话语作为双重本体论欺诈的合法性面纱；4. 人类从认知主体降级为被动数据源；5. 进步主义和人本主义行动者通过关注表面伦理规范，无意中为这种认识论置换提供了同意。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"技术封建秩序"作为分析当代数字资本主义的新概念框架；2. 揭示知识经济话语作为合法性面纱的理论机制；3. 发展"本体论断裂"理论来解释数字转型的本质；4. 批判进步主义伦理规范在技术封建秩序中的共谋作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供批判视角，超越表面伦理监管；2. 帮助社会行动者识别知识经济话语的欺骗性；3. 为数字权利倡导提供理论基础；4. 警示技术发展可能对人类能动性的侵蚀风险。

title: The Role of Finance in Supporting the Transition Toward the Circular Economy
affiliations: GREEN Research Centre - Bocconi University

detail.title: The Role of Finance in Supporting the Transition Toward the Circular Economy
detail.abstract: This paper aims to explore a new field of research on the relations between finance and the Circular Economy (CE). As a powerful driver of change in the real economy, the CE represents both a source of opportunities and a generator of threats for financial institutions that directly invest in non-financial companies, such as banks and specialized investors (for ex. private equity and private debt funds). First of all, literature on companies financing and, on the role, played by the financial system in supporting the growth of the real economy is explored, also considering specific features such as the finance for innovation and R&D. The goal is to point out the main elements that affect the company-financer relationship and the way the CE paradigm can positively influence and change them. Furthermore, an analysis on the changing shape of the economic activity provoked by the transition toward the CE, in terms of both business economics profile and sources of volatility, is carried out in order to understand what the opportunities and the threats are generated on the side of financial actors. Finally, the impact that the circular business models generate on the main credit risk metrics is considered, in order to understand what the major changes are financial institutions have to introduce in order to catch the advantages generated in terms of better creditworthiness of their counterparts. The CE offers some interesting opportunities to financial players, in terms of both more stable economics and a lower risk profile in the long period, but, at the same time, it asks for introducing important changes in the chain of activities of financial players. Only if financial actors deploy those changes inside their organizations, as well as improving their risk appetite in the short term, they will be able to catch the corresponding advantages, in terms of both investment opportunities and their superior sustainability in the long run.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨金融与循环经济(CE)关系的新研究领域，分析CE如何为金融机构带来机遇与威胁，并研究金融机构需要做出哪些改变来抓住这些机遇。
AI.research_question: 循环经济范式如何影响和改变公司-金融机构关系？金融机构需要引入哪些主要变化来抓住循环经济带来的机遇？
AI.motivation: 循环经济作为实体经济的强大驱动力，既为直接投资非金融公司的金融机构（如银行、私募股权和私募债务基金）带来机遇，也产生威胁，需要系统研究这一新兴领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司融资理论、金融系统支持实体经济增长理论、创新与研发融资理论、循环经济理论、信用风险管理理论
AI.method: 文献综述分析公司融资和金融系统支持实体经济增长的文献；分析向循环经济转型带来的经济活动形态变化；分析循环商业模式对主要信用风险指标的影响
AI.findings: 循环经济为金融参与者提供更稳定的经济性和长期更低风险特征的机会，但要求金融机构在活动链中引入重要变化；循环商业模式对信用风险指标产生积极影响，提高交易对手的信用质量
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了金融与循环经济关系的理论框架；阐明了循环经济范式如何影响公司-金融机构关系；提出了金融机构适应循环经济的理论模型
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构识别循环经济带来的机遇与威胁；提供金融机构需要引入的具体变革建议；帮助金融机构改进短期风险偏好以抓住长期投资机会

title: Altruism, Mutually Assured Temptation, and Preferences over Prisoner's Dilemmas
affiliations: Economics Department, University of Bath and Loyola University Maryland

detail.title: Altruism, Mutually Assured Temptation, and Preferences over Prisoner's Dilemmas
detail.abstract: Material payoffs tempt altruistic decision makers in isolation to sacrifice their virtuous commitments towards the society. Accordingly, they wish to ex-ante avoid more tempting decision-making environments in a two-stage framework where they first choose an environment and then an action within it. However, the notions of virtue and vice at the group level are philosophically problematic to define or predict. To address these issues, we extend the analysis to strategic settings where instead of decision-making environments, altruistic individuals first choose between prisoner's dilemma games with more or less tempting material payoffs and then play the game. Our focus on Prisoner's dilemma games is because these are classic models of social situations where both altruism and temptation co-exist naturally. We find that, in contrast to isolated decision makers who always fall for temptation and hence may avoid more tempting environments if given a choice, games with higher temptation can enhance cooperation among altruistic players. This curious possibility in the second stage implies that, in the first stage, a group of non-cooperative players may prefer prisoner's dilemma games with higher temptation as they agree, counterintuitively, that greed can enhance cooperation towards achieving their altruistic goals. We then show that material and psychological payoffs are aligned in equilibrium, so both materialist planners and decentralized altruistic agents may rationally select, ex-ante, more tempting games to better achieve both materialistic and altruistic ends.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，与孤立决策者总是屈服于诱惑不同，在囚徒困境博弈中，更高的诱惑反而能增强利他主义者的合作。非合作群体可能偏好更高诱惑的博弈，因为贪婪能促进合作以实现利他目标。
AI.research_question: 在战略环境中，利他主义个体是否会选择更高诱惑的囚徒困境博弈？更高的诱惑如何影响合作行为？
AI.motivation: 物质回报会诱惑利他决策者牺牲对社会的道德承诺，他们希望事前避免更诱惑的决策环境。但群体层面的美德与恶行难以定义或预测，需要扩展到战略环境分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 囚徒困境博弈理论（社会情境中利他与诱惑共存的经典模型）、行为经济学中的诱惑与自我控制理论、利他主义决策理论。
AI.method: 两阶段博弈分析框架：第一阶段选择囚徒困境博弈类型（高诱惑vs低诱惑），第二阶段在选定博弈中行动。理论模型分析均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1. 与孤立决策者总是屈服于诱惑不同，囚徒困境中更高诱惑能增强利他主义者的合作；2. 非合作群体可能偏好更高诱惑的博弈，因为贪婪能促进合作；3. 物质与心理回报在均衡中一致，理性主体可能选择更诱惑的博弈来实现物质和利他目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将诱惑-利他分析扩展到战略环境；2. 发现"贪婪促进合作"的反直觉机制；3. 建立了物质与心理回报在博弈均衡中的一致性理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为制度设计提供新视角：适当增加诱惑可能促进合作；2. 为组织管理提供启示：激励机制设计可考虑利用诱惑促进集体目标；3. 为政策制定者提供参考：理解群体决策中诱惑的双重作用。

title: Circumstances, Culture, and Inequality of Opportunity in Mexico: Integrating Roemer's Framework with Lamont's Cultural Processes Theory

detail.title: Circumstances, Culture, and Inequality of Opportunity in Mexico: Integrating Roemer's Framework with Lamont's Cultural Processes Theory
detail.abstract: This paper integrates Roemer’s ex-ante inequality of opportunity (IOp) frame­work with Lamont et al. (2014) cultural processes theory (racialization, stigma­tization, standardization, and evaluation) to both measure and interpret IOp in Mexico. Using nationally representative data from the ESRU-EMOVI 2023 sur­vey (N = 13,164), we apply conditional inference trees with Shapley value decomposition across a standard (K = 9) and an expanded (K = 12) spec­ification. IOp accounts for 26.6% to 30.6% of total income inequality (MLD). Household economic conditions at origin emerge as the single most impor­tant circumstance (20.8%), displacing parental education and occupation. Sex is the second-largest contributor (14.6%) and remains stable when household wealth is controlled, revealing gender-based evaluation as an independent IOp source. Geographic circumstances explain over a quarter of IOp through ter­ritorial stigmatization. Skin tone contributes modestly (1.1–2.4%), suggesting racialization operates as a distal process mediated through household wealth and educational access. Cohort analysis reveals declining total inequality (p < 0.001) alongside a suggestive increase in the IOp share (p = 0.061). These findings demonstrate that integrating cultural theory with quantitative measurement enriches both the estimation and interpretation of how birth circumstances shape economic outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文整合Roemer的机会不平等(IOp)框架与Lamont的文化过程理论，测量并解释墨西哥的机会不平等。研究发现家庭经济条件是最大影响因素(20.8%)，性别是第二大因素(14.6%)，地理因素通过地域污名化解释超过四分之一的IOp。
AI.research_question: 墨西哥的机会不平等程度如何？哪些出生环境因素通过何种文化过程机制影响经济结果？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多从定量角度测量机会不平等，但缺乏对背后文化过程机制的解释。本文旨在整合文化理论与定量测量，丰富对出生环境如何塑造经济结果的理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: Roemer的机会不平等(IOp)框架 + Lamont等人的文化过程理论（种族化、污名化、标准化、评价）
AI.method: 使用ESRU-EMOVI 2023全国代表性调查数据(N=13,164)，应用条件推断树和Shapley值分解，采用标准(K=9)和扩展(K=12)两种规格进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. IOp占总收入不平等的26.6%-30.6%；2. 家庭经济条件是最重要因素(20.8%)；3. 性别是第二大因素(14.6%)；4. 地理因素通过地域污名化解释超过四分之一的IOp；5. 肤色影响较小(1.1-2.4%)，主要通过家庭财富和教育机会间接作用；6. 队列分析显示总不平等下降但IOp份额可能增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 将文化过程理论整合到机会不平等测量框架中，提供了更丰富的解释机制，展示了种族化、污名化、标准化和评价等文化过程如何中介出生环境与经济结果之间的关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为墨西哥政策制定者提供了具体的干预目标：重点关注家庭经济条件、性别不平等和地域发展不平衡；揭示了文化过程在机会不平等中的重要作用，为设计更有效的平等政策提供了依据。

title: Exchange Rate Expectations and Currency Demand
affiliations: University of Geneva

detail.title: Exchange Rate Expectations and Currency Demand
detail.abstract: This paper develops a new method to extract exchange rate expectations from investment positions. I use relative allocations between otherwise identical exchange-traded funds (ETFs) offered with and without a currency hedge to measure investors' pure currency demand and infer a distribution of currency return expectations. These portfolioimplied expectations predict future exchange rates more accurately than survey-based expectations or expectations derived from macroeconomic models or currency pricing factors. Dispersion in portfolio-implied expectations accounts for 27% of exchange rate volatility, consistent with models of heterogeneous beliefs.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种从投资头寸中提取汇率预期的新方法，通过比较相同ETF的对冲与非对冲版本之间的相对配置来测量投资者的纯货币需求，并推断出货币回报预期的分布。这些投资组合隐含的预期比基于调查的预期、宏观经济模型或货币定价因子推导的预期更准确地预测未来汇率。投资组合隐含预期的分散度解释了27%的汇率波动，与异质信念模型一致。
AI.research_question: 如何从投资头寸中提取汇率预期？这些投资组合隐含的预期在预测未来汇率方面表现如何？它们与汇率波动有何关系？
AI.motivation: 传统的汇率预期测量方法（如调查数据、宏观经济模型）存在局限性，需要更准确、基于市场实际行为的预期测量方法。投资者在相同ETF的对冲与非对冲版本之间的选择反映了他们对货币的纯需求，这为提取汇率预期提供了新途径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质信念模型（heterogeneous beliefs models）、投资组合选择理论、汇率预期形成理论、市场微观结构理论。
AI.method: 使用相同ETF的对冲与非对冲版本之间的相对配置来测量投资者的纯货币需求，并推断出货币回报预期的分布。通过比较投资组合隐含的预期与其他预期测量方法（调查数据、宏观经济模型、货币定价因子）的预测准确性。
AI.findings:
1. 投资组合隐含的预期比调查数据、宏观经济模型或货币定价因子推导的预期更准确地预测未来汇率。
2. 投资组合隐含预期的分散度解释了27%的汇率波动。
3. 结果与异质信念模型一致，表明投资者预期的异质性对汇率波动有重要影响。
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了一种从实际投资行为中提取汇率预期的新方法。
2. 为异质信念模型提供了实证支持，表明投资者预期的分散度是汇率波动的重要来源。
3. 丰富了汇率预期形成和测量的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为投资者、政策制定者和研究人员提供了更准确的汇率预期测量工具。
2. 有助于理解汇率波动的驱动因素，特别是投资者预期异质性的作用。
3. 为资产配置和风险管理提供了新的信息源。

title: Hardware-Efficient 3D Medical Segmentation: Bridging the Dimensionality Gap in Vision Foundation Models via Spatial Continuity Regularization
affiliations: SRM Institute of Science and Technology and SRM Institute of Science and Technology

detail.title: Hardware-Efficient 3D Medical Segmentation: Bridging the Dimensionality Gap in Vision Foundation Models via Spatial Continuity Regularization
detail.abstract: Vision foundation models, such as the Segment Anything Model (SAM-3), have demonstrated exceptional zero-shot generalization in 2D medical image segmentation but often fail to maintain spatial coherence in 3D volumetric data. This dimensionality gap results in "staircase" artifacts and anatomically implausible reconstructions, undermining clinical utility. In this work, we investigate the trade-offs between computational efficiency and 3D consistency when adapting 2D foundation models to volumetric MRI and CT datasets. We first report a negative result: a Cross-Plane Contrastive Learning (CPCL) framework designed to enforce orthogonal consistency across axial, coronal, and sagittal views. While theoretically sound, CPCL introduces a prohibitive computational bottleneck, requiring over 40 GB of VRAM and a 4.5-fold increase in training latency, rendering iterative fine-tuning unfeasible in resource-constrained environments. To address these limitations, we propose Spatial Continuity Regularization (SCR-SAM), a lightweight longitudinal "tethering" strategy that optimizes adjacent slice pairs. Experimental results on BraTS (MRI) and KiTS (CT) datasets demonstrate that SCR-SAM reduces the Average Symmetric Surface Distance (ASSD) by approximately 79% on MRI volumes while maintaining a stable peak training VRAM of only 12.70 GB on standard Tesla T4 hardware. By preserving the semantic power of the 2D vision encoder without the overhead of complex 3D architectures, SCR-SAM provides a robust, hardware-accessible pathway for high-fidelity volumetric medical segmentation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种轻量化的空间连续性正则化方法（SCR-SAM），用于解决2D视觉基础模型在3D医学图像分割中的空间不一致性问题，在保持计算效率的同时显著提升了分割质量。
AI.research_question: 如何在保持计算效率的前提下，将2D视觉基础模型（如SAM-3）有效适应于3D医学图像分割，解决维度差异导致的空间不一致性问题？
AI.motivation: 2D视觉基础模型在医学图像分割中表现出优秀的零样本泛化能力，但在处理3D体数据时会产生"阶梯"伪影和解剖学上不合理的重建，影响临床实用性。现有方法如跨平面对比学习框架计算成本过高，不适用于资源受限环境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于2D视觉基础模型的零样本泛化能力，结合空间连续性约束理论，通过相邻切片对的优化来保持3D空间一致性，避免复杂的3D架构计算开销。
AI.method: 提出空间连续性正则化（SCR-SAM）方法，采用轻量化的纵向"绑定"策略，优化相邻切片对以保持空间一致性，相比跨平面对比学习框架大幅降低计算需求。
AI.findings: 在BraTS（MRI）和KiTS（CT）数据集上的实验表明，SCR-SAM将平均对称表面距离（ASSD）降低了约79%，同时训练峰值VRAM仅需12.70GB，相比CPCL方法（需要40+GB VRAM）计算效率显著提升。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）揭示了2D基础模型适应3D医学图像分割时的计算效率与空间一致性权衡问题；2）提出了轻量化的空间连续性正则化理论框架；3）为资源受限环境下的高质量3D医学图像分割提供了理论解决方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）开发了可在标准Tesla T4硬件上运行的实用系统；2）显著降低了计算资源需求（从40+GB降至12.70GB）；3）为临床环境提供了硬件可访问的高保真体积医学分割路径；4）保持了2D视觉编码器的语义能力，无需复杂3D架构。

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2026/3215
title: Who Owns Crypto in the Euro Area? Drivers of Crypto Adoption, Payment Use, and its Interaction with Fiat Cash
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Who Owns Crypto in the Euro Area? Drivers of Crypto Adoption, Payment Use, and its Interaction with Fiat Cash
detail.abstract: Using a survey of 39,507 adults in 17 euro-area countries, I find that crypto-asset owners and the niche subgroup of payers have distinct profiles. Owners – typically younger, male, and financially active – exhibit mixed preferences, valuing both cash-like privacy and card-like speed. Crypto payers display a cash-centric profile, seeking to replicate physical cash’s privacy and ease of use in digital form. While standard specifications show that holding cash reserves is positively associated with owning crypto – challenging the view that early adopters reject cash –, a multiple-instrument IV strategy exploiting pandemic-related payment shocks reveals a causal sign reversal: for compliers, building precautionary cash buffers reduces the probability of crypto ownership under uncertainty. These findings (1) explain the ownership-payment wedge as driven by user profiles beyond merchant-acceptance frictions, (2) show crypto and cash act as portfolio complements but substitutes under stress, and (3) may inform crypto regulation and CBDC design.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过欧元区调查发现，加密货币持有者与支付使用者具有不同特征：持有者多为年轻男性，偏好现金隐私与卡片速度的混合；支付使用者则追求现金式隐私体验。研究揭示现金与加密货币在正常情况下是投资组合互补品，但在压力下会成为替代品。
AI.research_question: 加密货币持有者与支付使用者的特征差异是什么？现金与加密货币在个人金融组合中是互补关系还是替代关系？
AI.motivation: 理解加密货币用户的真实行为模式，澄清加密货币与现金的关系（是替代还是互补），为加密货币监管和央行数字货币设计提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于支付偏好理论、投资组合理论和行为金融学，分析加密货币作为支付工具和投资资产的双重属性。
AI.method: 对17个欧元区国家的39,507名成年人进行问卷调查，采用标准回归分析和多重工具变量策略（利用疫情相关的支付冲击）进行因果推断。
AI.findings: 1. 加密货币持有者（年轻男性、金融活跃）偏好混合特征（现金隐私+卡片速度）；支付使用者则追求现金式隐私体验。2. 标准分析显示现金储备与持有加密货币正相关；但工具变量分析显示，在不确定性下建立预防性现金缓冲会降低加密货币持有概率。3. 现金与加密货币在正常情况下是投资组合互补品，在压力下成为替代品。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 解释了所有权-支付使用差异源于用户特征而非商户接受度摩擦。2. 揭示了现金与加密货币在不同情境下的互补/替代关系。3. 挑战了"早期采用者拒绝现金"的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币监管政策提供实证依据，为央行数字货币设计提供用户行为洞察，帮助金融机构理解加密货币用户的真实需求。

title: How Cyclone Traps People into Poverty: Empirical Evidence from Bangladesh
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: How Cyclone Traps People into Poverty: Empirical Evidence from Bangladesh

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is no conflict of interest related to this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used previously collected survey data. All participants provided informed consent at the time of the survey, and the research was conducted in accordance with relevant ethical guidelines. No new data collection involving human subjects was performed.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract: This study examines whether a poverty trap emerges in the aftermath of a disaster, what determines its depth in terms of income level, and whether consumption-side factors contribute to its persistence. It focuses on the coastal region of Bangladesh affected by Cyclone Aila in May 2009 and empirically analyzes how disaster coping strategies influence asset growth. The impact of Aila on the extent of poverty traps is assessed by comparing affected areas with a control group of unaffected regions, using primary data from approximately 890 households in coastal Bangladesh. The theoretical framework demonstrates that when production is non-convex, disaster-induced asset losses can generate poverty traps, pushing households toward a lower equilibrium among multiple equilibria at different asset levels. Employing both semi-parametric and parametric approaches, the findings reveal multiple equilibria in asset index–based trajectories in disaster-affected areas, indicating the presence of a poverty trap, whereas income convergence between high- and low-income households is observed in unaffected areas. The results further suggest that the depth of the poverty trap is reduced for households able to shift to a higher-income equilibrium, and, based on a natural experimental design, poorer households in affected areas are more likely to remain trapped at lower income levels compared to those in unaffected regions.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨灾害后是否会出现贫困陷阱、其深度由什么决定，以及消费因素是否影响其持续性。以2009年孟加拉国艾拉飓风受灾地区为案例，通过对比受灾与未受灾地区，发现受灾地区存在基于资产指数的多重均衡贫困陷阱，而未受灾地区则呈现收入趋同。
AI.research_question: 灾害后是否会出现贫困陷阱？贫困陷阱的深度（收入水平）由什么决定？消费因素是否影响贫困陷阱的持续性？
AI.motivation: 理解灾害对贫困动态的影响，特别是灾害应对策略如何影响资产增长和贫困陷阱的形成与持续性，为灾害风险管理提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于非凸生产函数理论，灾害导致的资产损失可能产生贫困陷阱，使家庭在不同资产水平的多重均衡中趋向较低均衡。
AI.method: 使用半参数和参数方法，对比孟加拉国沿海地区约890户家庭（受灾与未受灾）的初级数据，采用自然实验设计。
AI.findings: 受灾地区存在基于资产指数的多重均衡贫困陷阱，而未受灾地区呈现收入趋同；能够转向更高收入均衡的家庭贫困陷阱深度减轻；受灾地区较贫困家庭更可能被困在较低收入水平。
AI.theory_contributions: 从理论上证明了非凸生产条件下灾害如何导致贫困陷阱，为灾害经济学和贫困动态研究提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为灾害风险管理政策提供依据，强调需要帮助受灾家庭转向更高收入均衡，特别是针对较贫困家庭的干预措施。

title: Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and the Institutional Turn: Legal Architectures and Financial Governance in the Age of Distributional AGI

detail.title: Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and the Institutional Turn: Legal Architectures and Financial Governance in the Age of Distributional AGI
detail.abstract: The proliferation of agentic artificial intelligence systems-characterized by autonomous goal-seeking, tool use, and multi-agent coordination-presents unprecedented challenges to existing legal and financial regulatory frameworks. While traditional AI governance has focused on model-level alignment through training-time interventions such as Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), the deployment of large language models (LLMs) as persistent agents embedded within socio-technical systems necessitates a paradigm shift toward institutional governance structures. This paper examines the intersection of agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and their implications for legal accountability and financial market integrity. Through a comprehensive analysis of the Institutional AI framework proposed by Pierucci et al. [1], we argue that alignment must be reconceptualized as a mechanism design problem involving runtime governance graphs, sanction functions, and observable behavioral constraints rather than internalized constitutional values. We address the critical deficit identified by LeCun regarding the absence of world models in current agents, demonstrating how RAG architectures function as externalized epistemic infrastructure that grounds agentic cognition in verifiable data repositories. The paper subsequently interrogates the legal implications of these systems under the European Union's Artificial Intelligence Act (EU AI Act) and the regulatory thresholds established by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and European Central Bank (ECB), proposing justified compliance boundaries for high-risk financial applications. Furthermore, we acknowledge significant governance gaps within Decentralized Finance (DeFi) protocols where institutional oversight mechanisms face structural limitations. By synthesizing technical insights from multi-agent systems, constitutional AI limitations, and offensive security frameworks, this work advances a jurisprudential foundation for agentic AI that prioritizes defensible audit trails, incentive-compatible compliance, and systemic stability over opaque internal alignment guarantees. The analysis concludes that the future of AI governance lies not in perfecting isolated model behavior, but in architecting institutional environments where compliant behavior emerges as the dominant strategy through carefully calibrated payoff landscapes.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了智能体AI（具有自主目标寻求、工具使用和多智能体协调能力）对现有法律和金融监管框架带来的挑战。论文主张从传统的模型级对齐转向制度治理结构，将RAG架构视为外部化认知基础设施，并分析了智能体AI在欧盟AI法案和金融监管下的合规边界，特别关注DeFi领域的治理缺口。
AI.research_question: 智能体AI和RAG架构如何影响法律问责和金融市场完整性？如何重新构建AI对齐概念以适应制度治理需求？
AI.motivation: 传统AI治理专注于通过RLHF等训练时干预实现模型级对齐，但智能体AI作为嵌入社会技术系统的持久性代理，需要向制度治理结构转变。当前智能体缺乏世界模型，且DeFi协议存在治理缺口，需要新的治理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Pierucci等人的制度AI框架；2. 机制设计理论（将对齐重新概念化为机制设计问题）；3. 多智能体系统理论；4. 宪法AI局限性；5. 进攻性安全框架；6. 法律和金融监管理论（欧盟AI法案、FCA、ECB监管）
AI.method: 综合分析方法：1. 对制度AI框架的全面分析；2. 技术架构分析（RAG作为外部化认知基础设施）；3. 法律和监管框架分析（欧盟AI法案、FCA、ECB）；4. 治理缺口识别（DeFi协议）；5. 多学科理论综合（技术、法律、金融）
AI.findings: 1. RAG架构可作为外部化认知基础设施，弥补智能体缺乏世界模型的问题；2. 对齐应重新概念化为涉及运行时治理图、制裁函数和可观察行为约束的机制设计问题；3. 智能体AI在欧盟AI法案和金融监管下需要明确的合规边界；4. DeFi协议存在显著的治理缺口；5. AI治理的未来在于构建制度环境，使合规行为成为主导策略
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将AI对齐重新概念化为制度治理问题而非内部价值对齐；2. 提出RAG作为外部化认知基础设施的理论框架；3. 建立智能体AI的法理学基础，强调可辩护审计追踪、激励兼容合规和系统稳定性；4. 整合多智能体系统、宪法AI和进攻性安全框架的理论见解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为高风险金融应用提出合理的合规边界；2. 识别DeFi协议的治理缺口并提出改进方向；3. 为监管机构提供智能体AI治理的实践框架；4. 为AI系统设计者提供制度治理架构指导；5. 强调可审计性和系统稳定性的实践重要性

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2026/3217
title: Monetary Policy under Multiple Financing Constraints
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Research Department and European Central Bank (ECB) - Directorate General Research

detail.title: Monetary Policy under Multiple Financing Constraints
detail.abstract: We revisit the credit channel of monetary policy when firms face multiple financing constraints, a common feature of corporate financing we document empirically. Our theory shows that the multiplicity of constraints dampens the transmission of expansionary policy to firm borrowing and investment notably but amplifies the transmission of policy tightening. This asymmetry arises because, when policy tightens (eases), the most (least) responsive constraint binds. Using U.S. firm-level data and exploiting a quasi-natural experiment, we find strong support for these predictions and for our proposed channel. Embedding the mechanism into a New Keynesian framework, we find that the drop in investment after contractionary shocks is twice as large as its increase following equally-sized expansionary shocks, thus providing an explanation for why monetary policy tightenings have stronger effects than easings, a longstanding puzzle in monetary economics. Moreover, our analysis implies that the effectiveness of monetary policy is strongly determined by the distribution of financial constraints across firms and that similar asymmetries likely characterize the transmission of other macroeconomic shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业在面临多重融资约束时，货币政策的信贷传导机制。研究发现，多重约束会抑制扩张性政策对企业借贷和投资的传导，但会放大紧缩性政策的传导效应，形成不对称性。
AI.research_question: 当企业面临多重融资约束时，货币政策的信贷传导机制如何运作？这种多重约束如何影响货币政策对企业借贷和投资的不对称效应？
AI.motivation: 企业通常面临多种融资约束，这是公司融资的常见特征。传统的货币政策信贷传导理论往往假设单一约束，而现实中企业面临多重约束，这可能解释货币政策传导的不对称性（紧缩效应强于扩张效应），这是货币经济学中长期存在的谜题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信贷渠道理论，构建企业在多重融资约束下的理论模型。将多重约束机制嵌入新凯恩斯主义框架，分析货币政策传导的不对称性。
AI.method: 1. 理论建模：构建企业在多重融资约束下的理论模型；2. 实证分析：使用美国企业层面数据，利用准自然实验验证理论预测；3. 宏观模拟：将机制嵌入新凯恩斯主义框架进行模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1. 多重约束会抑制扩张性政策对企业借贷和投资的传导，但会放大紧缩性政策的传导效应；2. 紧缩性冲击后的投资下降幅度是同等规模扩张性冲击后投资增加幅度的两倍；3. 货币政策有效性强烈取决于企业间金融约束的分布；4. 类似的不对称性可能也存在于其他宏观经济冲击的传导中。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了企业在多重融资约束下的货币政策传导理论；2. 解释了货币政策传导的不对称性（紧缩效应强于扩张效应）；3. 为货币经济学中长期存在的谜题提供了理论解释；4. 扩展了信贷渠道理论，考虑了现实中的多重约束特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 帮助政策制定者理解货币政策传导的不对称性；2. 表明货币政策有效性取决于企业金融约束的分布；3. 为评估宏观经济冲击的影响提供了新视角；4. 对货币政策设计和实施具有重要启示意义。

reference: ECB Working Paper No. 2026/3216
title: Dynamic Credit Constraints: Theory and Evidence from Credit Lines
affiliations: Sveriges Riksbank, Sveriges Riksbank - Research Division, University of Southern California - Marshall School of Business - Finance and Business Economics Department and Sveriges Riksbank - Research Division

detail.title: Dynamic Credit Constraints: Theory and Evidence from Credit Lines
detail.abstract: We use a comprehensive Swedish credit register to document that firms across the size distribution have access to substantial borrowing capacity via credit lines. However, most firms choose not to use all available credit, even though interest rates are low compared to their return on equity. The low utilization of credit is consistent with a theoretical model in which utilization rates decrease with both real and financial uncertainty. We estimate the model structurally at the firm level and find that financial uncertainty driven by liquidity shocks is much more important than real uncertainty driven by cash flow shocks for explaining the low utilization of credit.

AI.tldr: 瑞典企业普遍拥有大量未使用的信贷额度，即使贷款利率低于股本回报率。研究发现，企业信贷使用率低主要受金融不确定性（流动性冲击）而非实际不确定性（现金流冲击）影响。
AI.research_question: 为什么企业即使面临低于股本回报率的低利率，仍然选择不完全使用其信贷额度？信贷使用率低的主要驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 企业普遍拥有未使用的信贷额度，这与传统金融理论相悖（企业应最大化利用低成本债务）。理解这一现象对理解企业融资决策和信贷市场效率有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于不确定性理论，构建理论模型表明信贷使用率随实际不确定性（现金流冲击）和金融不确定性（流动性冲击）的增加而降低。
AI.method: 使用瑞典全面信贷登记数据，在微观企业层面进行结构模型估计，区分实际不确定性和金融不确定性对信贷使用率的影响。
AI.findings: 金融不确定性（流动性冲击）比实际不确定性（现金流冲击）对解释低信贷使用率更为重要。企业保留信贷额度作为应对未来流动性冲击的缓冲。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业融资理论，强调金融不确定性在信贷决策中的核心作用，解释了为何企业宁愿支付机会成本也要保留未使用的信贷额度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行信贷政策制定提供依据，帮助企业更好地管理流动性风险，为监管机构理解企业信贷行为提供新视角。

title: When Environmental Policy Backfires: Air Pollution Warnings and Influenza Transmission in South Korea
affiliations: Auburn University

detail.title: When Environmental Policy Backfires: Air Pollution Warnings and Influenza Transmission in South Korea
detail.abstract: Air-quality warnings aim to protect public health by reducing outdoor exposure but may generate unintended behavioral spillovers. Using daily province-level data from South Korea (2015–2019) and exploiting the staggered rollout of real-time Emergency Disaster Texts (EDT), I show that particulate matter (PM) warnings increase influenza incidence through an information-driven behavioral response. A difference-in-differences analysis finds that post-warning flu incidence rises significantly after EDT implementation, an effect absent in the pre-EDT period. Event-study estimates reveal no pre-trend, with incidence beginning to rise around day 3 and peaking 25–40 days after an alert — consistent with secondary transmission chains seeded by warning-induced indoor congregation rather than a single incubation cycle. Online search data confirm that warnings trigger rapid substitution toward commercial indoor venues, with behavioral reversion within two days, supporting the interpretation that a brief congregation episode generates a prolonged epidemiological arc. Effects are concentrated among school-aged children and stronger in areas with greater alert exposure. Falsification tests show that physical pollution shocks predict external-organ conditions such as dermatitis, while only the warning signal predicts influenza, isolating an informational behavioral channel from direct biological exposure. These findings highlight nontrivial hidden externalities in environmental alert design and suggest that coupling pollution warnings with indoor hygiene guidance could mitigate the unintended epidemiological costs of high-salience alert systems.

AI.tldr: 韩国研究发现，空气污染警报通过信息驱动的行为反应增加了流感发病率。警报促使人们转向室内聚集，导致流感传播增加，而非直接生物暴露效应。
AI.research_question: 空气污染警报如何通过行为反应影响流感发病率？警报是否会产生意外的流行病学外部性？
AI.motivation: 空气质量警报旨在通过减少户外暴露来保护公共健康，但可能产生意外的行为溢出效应。需要理解这些警报如何通过信息驱动的行为反应影响疾病传播。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为经济学（信息驱动的行为反应）、流行病学（疾病传播机制）、环境政策评估（政策意外后果）
AI.method: 使用韩国省级日度数据（2015-2019年），采用交错实施的实时紧急灾害短信（EDT）作为自然实验，进行双重差分分析。结合事件研究法、在线搜索数据验证行为反应，并进行证伪测试。
AI.findings: 1. PM警报显著增加流感发病率，效应在EDT实施后出现；2. 流感发病率在警报后第3天开始上升，25-40天后达到峰值，符合二次传播链模式；3. 在线搜索数据显示警报促使人们转向商业室内场所；4. 效应集中在学龄儿童和警报暴露更多的地区；5. 证伪测试显示只有警报信号预测流感，而非物理污染冲击。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了环境警报的信息驱动行为机制；2. 识别了警报的意外流行病学外部性；3. 区分了信息行为渠道与直接生物暴露效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议在污染警报中增加室内卫生指导；2. 优化高显著性警报系统设计以减少意外成本；3. 为政策制定者提供考虑行为反应的综合风险评估框架。

title: Resource Tenure Issues in the Settlement of Sudan's Dislocated Population

detail.title: Resource Tenure Issues in the Settlement of Sudan's Dislocated Population
detail.abstract: The number of displaced people in Sudan as a result of conflict and famine over nearly two decades of war has been estimated to be in the millions. The lengthy period of time that many local populations have been dislocated and the consequent disruption of food producing activities poses complicated problems in both near-term food security and the longer-term rehabilitation of the country's traditional agricultural sector. Recovery of households and production systems after years of conflict and famine for the displaced will involve more than simply a return to home areas. Resource use and access arrangements, will emerge contested and reconfigured as claimants with perceived rights based on various past customary and state tenure regimes seek to exercise these rights in a changed human and biophysical landscape. This paper will examine some of the land tenure issues likely to become important as large populations of Sudan's internally displaced seek to re-engage in agricultural production systems they are familiar with. In the more populous agriculturally endowed locations where the recovery of many households and numerous production systems will initially be focused, establishing or re-establishing a mutually agreed upon tenure system (or set of systems) and modes of resource use and access that are widely seen as equitable, secure, inclusive and legitimate at the national level will, while complicated, be important to agricultural production, and food security.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨苏丹长期冲突和饥荒导致大规模人口流离失所后，农业恢复过程中土地权属问题的重要性，分析不同权利主张者基于历史习惯和国家权属制度在变化环境中争夺资源使用权的问题。
AI.research_question: 苏丹大规模国内流离失所人口重新参与农业生产系统时，土地权属问题将如何影响农业恢复和粮食安全？
AI.motivation: 苏丹近二十年冲突和饥荒导致数百万人流离失所，长期流离失所和农业生产活动中断给近期粮食安全和长期农业部门恢复带来复杂问题，恢复过程不仅仅是返回原籍地那么简单。
AI.theoretical_framework: 土地权属理论、资源使用权和获取安排理论、习惯权属制度与国家权属制度的冲突与协调、后冲突社会资源重新配置理论。
AI.method: 基于文献分析和理论推演的概念性分析论文，探讨苏丹特定情境下的土地权属问题。
AI.findings: 资源使用和获取安排将在不同权利主张者之间产生争议和重新配置，这些主张者基于各种历史习惯和国家权属制度寻求在变化的人类和生物物理环境中行使权利。在人口密集、农业资源丰富的地区，建立或重建广泛认可为公平、安全、包容和合法的权属系统和资源使用模式对农业生产和粮食安全至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 为后冲突社会土地权属重建理论提供具体案例，分析习惯权属与国家权属制度在流离失所人口回归过程中的冲突与协调机制，丰富资源重新配置理论在农业恢复中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为苏丹政府和国际组织在流离失所人口农业恢复过程中制定土地政策提供参考，强调建立公平、安全、包容和合法的权属系统的重要性，有助于避免土地冲突并促进农业生产恢复。

title: Multidimensional Screening with Element-wise Monotone Independence
affiliations: Columbia University - Columbia Business School and Columbia University, Graduate School of Arts and Sciences, Students

detail.title: Multidimensional Screening with Element-wise Monotone Independence
detail.abstract: This paper develops a Myersonian approach to multidimensional screening with a finite action set. The principal's objective admits a virtual-surplus representation that yields score-based allocation rules. We identify a simple multidimensional regularity condition-element-wise monotone independence-under which the score-maximizing allocation rule is globally optimal and implementable. The result delivers a tractable characterization of optimal multidimensional mechanisms through virtual values and deterministic scoring rules.

AI.tldr: 本文为有限行动集的多维筛选问题开发了Myersonian方法，通过虚拟剩余表示得到基于分数的分配规则，在元素单调独立性条件下证明了分数最大化分配规则的全局最优性和可实施性。
AI.research_question: 如何在有限行动集的多维筛选问题中设计最优机制？
AI.motivation: 多维机制设计通常很复杂，缺乏像一维Myerson机制那样的简洁特征化，本文旨在为有限行动集的多维筛选问题开发类似Myerson的简洁方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: Myerson机制设计理论，多维筛选理论，虚拟剩余方法，分数分配规则。
AI.method: 开发基于虚拟剩余表示的Myersonian方法，提出元素单调独立性条件，通过分数最大化分配规则来特征化最优机制。
AI.findings: 在元素单调独立性条件下，分数最大化分配规则是全局最优且可实施的，这为多维机制提供了通过虚拟值和确定性评分规则的可处理特征化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将Myerson方法扩展到多维有限行动集筛选；2) 提出元素单调独立性条件；3) 证明了分数最大化分配规则的最优性；4) 提供了多维机制的可处理特征化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实际多维机制设计提供了简洁实用的工具，使决策者能够通过虚拟值和评分规则设计最优机制，降低了多维机制设计的复杂性。

title: Can the Trump Administration’s Decision not to Participate in BEPS 2.0 be Justified in Terms of Political Right?
affiliations: National Law University Delhi

detail.title: Can the Trump Administration’s Decision not to Participate in BEPS 2.0 be Justified in Terms of Political Right?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This is my assignment submitted as a part of internal assessment at the Warwick, University.

detail.abstract:
On the 20th of January, alongside numerous controversial executive orders, United States of America (US) President Donald Trump issued a surprising executive order affirming that the US would opt out of the OECD initiative BEPS 2.0. Further, the US Treasury Secretary must develop options for a response to be presented to the President in 60 days, specifically by March 21, 2025. On the 3rd of February, the US also opted out of the United Nations (UN) Framework Convention on International Tax Cooperation. Following the US decision to pull out of the Global Tax Deal, countries such as India, for instance, are sceptical after signing global tax agreements without the support of one of the world’s most powerful nations’ economies.

Political rhetoric aside, this essay answers a different yet significant theoretical question often forgotten when assessing Trump’s move: Can the Trump administration’s decision not to participate in BEPS 2.0 be justified in terms of “political right”?

Political right, in relation to international business taxation, is understood as the legal ramifications of political and diplomatic decisions made in tax policy. The decisions are made through tax statutes or bilateral and multilateral taxing treaties. Tax politics can be understood as a national government’s response to manage the geopolitical tension behind taxes, both politically and diplomatically. The geopolitical aspect of taxation is the scarce resource of investment capital, for instance, foreign direct investment (FDI), and tax co-operation or competition (as an aspect of tax policy). While these are operational ways in which tax politics have been pursued to manage that scarcity, ensuring this means that tax policy choices, including corporate income tax rate choices, made in the national interest may not necessarily be within the global welfare norms. The interests of multinational groups (MNGs) and the national interest of national governing bodies do not always align. It is this misalignment that could have a dubious effect on the formation of taxation policy, and therefore on the political right of taxation policy.

This paper argues that Trump’s decision to leave BEPS 2.0 was justifiable when viewed from a complex and multifaceted “political right” perspective.  In the first place, the Republican Party is viewed as a far-right party. The exercise of political rights would mean favouring market freedom and limited government. The two-pillar solution can impose global tax standards that would likely restrict free market choices and favour government involvement in the economy, which conflicts with the Republican Party’s core values.  Second, based on game theory, it is argued that the decision to abstain from BEPS 2.0, specifically the elements that pertain to the allocation of taxing rights to market jurisdictions and a global minimum tax regime in source countries, can be characterised as a strategic and prudent choice. While controversial, the decision will help preserve the tax revenue from their large high-tech conglomerate.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨特朗普政府退出BEPS 2.0的决定是否可以从"政治权利"角度得到正当性辩护。作者认为，从共和党的自由市场理念和博弈论的战略考量来看，这一决定具有政治正当性。
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府决定不参与BEPS 2.0的决定是否可以从"政治权利"角度得到正当性辩护？
AI.motivation: 美国退出BEPS 2.0和联合国国际税收合作框架公约引发全球关注，但现有讨论多关注政治修辞，而忽略了从"政治权利"理论角度分析这一决策的正当性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治权利理论（在国际商业税收背景下）、税收政治学、地缘政治理论、博弈论
AI.method: 理论分析框架，结合政治权利概念、税收政治学和博弈论进行论证分析
AI.findings: 特朗普退出BEPS 2.0的决定从政治权利角度看是正当的：1)符合共和党自由市场、有限政府的核心价值；2)从博弈论角度看是保护美国高科技企业税收收入的战略选择
AI.theory_contributions: 将"政治权利"概念应用于国际税收政策分析，为评估国家税收政策决策提供了新的理论视角，特别是在全球税收协调与国家主权冲突的背景下
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了评估国际税收协议参与决策的理论框架，帮助理解国家利益与全球税收协调之间的张力，特别是在大国退出全球税收协议的情况下

title: Arts of Witness: Resilience Amid Technological Acceleration, Geopolitical Volatility, and Media Transformation in Contemporary South Asia
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Arts of Witness: Resilience Amid Technological Acceleration, Geopolitical Volatility, and Media Transformation in Contemporary South Asia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None. Independent research without finance or influence from any stakeholders.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: Self Funded

detail.abstract: This paper develops the concept of the 'Arts of Witness' as a framework for understanding resilience in an age defined by technological acceleration, geopolitical volatility, and media transformation. Drawing on ethnographic experience spanning the 2014 Wembley Stadium address by Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and UK Prime Minister David Cameron, the digitised isolation of the COVID-19 pandemic, and first-hand reporting from the 2021 G20 Rome Summit, the study situates South Asia within a broader global reconfiguration of power and narrative authority. Engaging leadership theory, brand strategy, and media ethics scholarship alongside contemporary reports from the World Economic Forum, Reuters Institute, and European Commission, the paper argues that witnessing has shifted from a largely Western-exported normative practice into a multidirectional, contested, and technologically mediated performance. It examines the rise of Artificial Intelligence in journalism, regulatory pressures on media institutions, and the tension between traditional professional journalism and social media ecosystems. The paper concludes that the Arts of Witness represent not merely documentation but an ethical assertion of meaning and accountability. In an era where algorithms shape visibility and geopolitical narratives are fiercely contested, understanding how we witness-through which platforms, under what political pressures, and within which cultural frameworks-is central to navigating the future of democratic discourse.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"见证艺术"的概念框架，用于理解在技术加速、地缘政治动荡和媒体转型时代中的韧性。研究通过民族志方法分析了从2014年莫迪-卡梅伦演讲到COVID-19数字隔离再到2021年G20峰会等一系列事件，探讨了见证如何从西方主导的规范实践转变为多向、争议和技术中介的表演。
AI.research_question: 在技术加速、地缘政治动荡和媒体转型的时代，见证如何从西方主导的规范实践转变为多向、争议和技术中介的表演？见证艺术如何成为构建意义和问责的伦理实践？
AI.motivation: 当前时代面临技术加速、地缘政治动荡和媒体转型三大挑战，传统见证模式受到冲击。研究旨在理解在这一背景下，见证如何演变并成为构建韧性的重要框架，特别是在南亚等地区在全球权力和叙事权威重构中的角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导力理论、品牌战略、媒体伦理、见证理论、技术中介传播理论、地缘政治叙事理论
AI.method: 民族志研究，涵盖2014年莫迪-卡梅伦演讲、COVID-19数字隔离、2021年G20罗马峰会等事件；结合世界经济论坛、路透社研究所、欧盟委员会等机构的当代报告分析
AI.findings: 见证已从西方主导的规范实践转变为多向、争议和技术中介的表演；人工智能在新闻业兴起，媒体机构面临监管压力，传统专业新闻与社交媒体生态系统存在张力；见证艺术不仅是记录，更是意义构建和问责的伦理主张
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"见证艺术"的概念框架，丰富了见证理论；将南亚置于全球权力和叙事权威重构的背景下分析；整合了领导力、品牌战略和媒体伦理等多学科视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为媒体机构、政策制定者和公民社会提供了理解当代见证实践的框架；有助于应对算法塑造可见性和地缘政治叙事争议的挑战；为民主话语的未来发展提供指导

title: From Protecting Competitors to Protecting Competition: The Past, Present, and Future of the Robinson-Patman Act
affiliations: Department of Justice and

detail.title: From Protecting Competitors to Protecting Competition: The Past, Present, and Future of the Robinson-Patman Act
detail.abstract: Nearly a century has passed since the enactment of the Robinson-Patman Act (RPA). An amendment to the Clayton Act, the RPA sits uncomfortably under the umbrella of American antitrust law. Among its many unique features is its proscription of price discrimination that harms competition. A fundamental question, therefore, is how a price discrimination law can operate to facilitate the goal of antitrust. This paper attempts to answer that question. This article argues that the history, structure, and text of the RPA require courts to evaluate the RPA’s competitive-effects language consistent with the other provisions of the Clayton Act and the broader antitrust laws. The RPA is principally concerned with two types of conduct: primary and secondary line. The Supreme Court has harmonized the former with the broader antitrust laws. Drawing on the history, structure, and text of the RPA, this article argues that courts should employ the raising rivals’ costs framework when evaluating secondary-line theories of harm.

AI.tldr: 本文主张法院应运用"提高竞争对手成本"框架来评估《罗宾逊-帕特曼法案》中的二级损害理论，以使其与《克莱顿法案》及其他反垄断法律保持一致。
AI.research_question: 价格歧视法律如何运作以实现反垄断目标？具体而言，法院应如何评估《罗宾逊-帕特曼法案》中的二级损害理论？
AI.motivation: 《罗宾逊-帕特曼法案》作为《克莱顿法案》的修正案，在美国反垄断法律体系中地位尴尬。该法案禁止损害竞争的价格歧视，但如何使其与反垄断目标保持一致是一个根本性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主要基于《罗宾逊-帕特曼法案》的历史、结构和文本分析，结合《克莱顿法案》及其他反垄断法律的原则，运用"提高竞争对手成本"理论框架。
AI.method: 采用法律解释方法，分析《罗宾逊-帕特曼法案》的历史背景、法律结构和文本内容，结合最高法院对一级损害的判例，提出对二级损害评估的理论框架。
AI.findings: 最高法院已将一级损害理论与更广泛的反垄断法律相协调。基于《罗宾逊-帕特曼法案》的历史、结构和文本，法院在评估二级损害理论时应采用"提高竞争对手成本"框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 为《罗宾逊-帕特曼法案》的二级损害评估提供了统一的理论框架，将价格歧视法律与反垄断目标更紧密地联系起来，丰富了反垄断法律理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院提供具体的司法评估框架，使《罗宾逊-帕特曼法案》的执行更加一致和可预测，有助于法律实践中的统一适用。

title: The Unintended Consequences of Low Emission Zones: Evidence from Madrid Central
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin)

detail.title: The Unintended Consequences of Low Emission Zones: Evidence from Madrid Central
detail.abstract: We investigate the spillover effects of low emission zones on traffic, air pollution, and health, focusing on Madrid Central. Combining satellite and  station-level air quality data with nearly 4,000 traffic sensors, we find that while the policy reduced NO2 and PM2.5 inside the restricted area, it displaced  traffic by 2.7 percent city-wide, generating heterogeneous spillovers: PM2.5 increased by up-to 0.4 µg/m3 in some districts while decreasing in others. Two        spatial channels shape these spillovers: wind transport carries cleaner air from the restriction zone to downwind neighborhoods, while more distant districts  bear the full cost of rerouted traffic. These pollution increases fall disproportionately on lower-income peripheral neighborhoods. Comparing districts by the     direction of their estimated pollution change, we find suggestive evidence of higher hospitalization and mortality rates in pollution-increase vis-à-vis  pollution-decrease districts. These findings suggest that geographically targeted driving restrictions can redistribute pollution in ways that systematically  disadvantage peripheral communities.

AI.tldr: 研究马德里低排放区政策对交通、空气污染和健康的溢出效应，发现政策虽然降低了限制区内的污染，但导致全市交通转移2.7%，产生异质性溢出：部分区域PM2.5上升，部分下降。污染增加主要影响低收入外围社区，这些区域的住院率和死亡率也更高。
AI.research_question: 低排放区政策对交通、空气污染和健康有何溢出效应？这些效应如何在不同区域间分布？
AI.motivation: 地理针对性驾驶限制政策（如低排放区）旨在改善城市空气质量，但可能产生意外的空间溢出效应，特别是对周边社区的影响需要深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间溢出效应理论、环境正义理论、交通转移效应、污染再分配机制
AI.method: 结合卫星和站点空气质量数据，使用近4000个交通传感器，分析马德里中央低排放区政策实施前后的变化，采用空间分析方法识别污染转移路径。
AI.findings: 1. 政策降低了限制区内NO2和PM2.5浓度；2. 导致全市交通量转移2.7%；3. 产生异质性溢出：部分区域PM2.5上升达0.4 µg/m³，部分下降；4. 两个空间渠道：风传输将清洁空气带到下风区，较远区域承担交通改道成本；5. 污染增加主要影响低收入外围社区；6. 污染增加区域的住院率和死亡率更高。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了地理针对性环境政策的复杂空间溢出效应；2. 识别了污染再分配的两个空间渠道；3. 为环境正义理论提供了实证支持，显示政策可能系统性损害外围社区。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提醒政策制定者考虑低排放区政策的意外后果；2. 强调需要配套措施减轻外围社区的负担；3. 为更公平的城市环境政策设计提供依据；4. 建议采用更全面的评估框架，考虑空间分布效应。

title: Green Silence: Double Machine Learning Carbon Emissions Under Sample Selection Bias
affiliations: University of Glasgow, Adam Smith Business School, EDHEC Business School and Swiss Finance Institute - University of Geneva

detail.title: Green Silence: Double Machine Learning Carbon Emissions Under Sample Selection Bias
detail.abstract: Voluntary carbon disclosure creates a paradox where firms strategically choose whether to report emissions, with high emitters often remaining silent to exploit estimation biases. This selfselection problem distorts climate risk pricing and policy analysis. We propose a three-step Heckman-inspired framework for high-dimensional data using kernel group lasso, double machine learning, and peer firm information. An empirical study of 3,444 U.S. firms (2010-2023) finds strong evidence of selection bias. Naïve imputation methods underestimate emissions, leading to a $2.6 billion carbon tax shortfall and up to $525 billion in hidden social costs. Correcting for non-disclosure bias reveals a higher carbon premium.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种解决企业自愿碳披露中自选择偏误的三步框架，发现传统估算方法低估排放量，导致数十亿美元碳税缺口和隐藏社会成本，纠正偏误后显示出更高的碳溢价。
AI.research_question: 如何解决企业自愿碳披露中的自选择偏误问题，以及这种偏误对气候风险定价和政策分析的影响？
AI.motivation: 企业自愿碳披露存在自选择问题，高排放企业往往选择不披露以利用估算偏误，这扭曲了气候风险定价和政策分析，需要开发新方法来纠正这种偏误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Heckman选择模型的理论框架，结合高维数据处理、机器学习方法和同行企业信息，解决自选择偏误问题。
AI.method: 三步框架：1) 核群组LASSO处理高维数据；2) 双重机器学习；3) 利用同行企业信息。对美国3,444家企业2010-2023年的数据进行实证研究。
AI.findings: 发现存在显著的选择偏误，传统估算方法低估排放量，导致26亿美元碳税缺口和高达5250亿美元的隐藏社会成本，纠正偏误后显示出更高的碳溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了解决碳披露自选择偏误的新理论框架，将Heckman模型扩展到高维数据环境，结合机器学习和同行信息。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供更准确的碳披露估算方法，帮助识别隐藏的社会成本，改进碳税设计和气候风险定价。

title: Geographical Indications and Authorised Users in India: A Critical Analysis with Special Reference to Muga Silk of Assam

detail.title: Geographical Indications and Authorised Users in India: A Critical Analysis with Special Reference to Muga Silk of Assam
detail.abstract: The effectiveness of the Geographical Indications (GI) regime in India significantly depends on the participation of "Authorised Users" (AUs), who are legally empowered to use registered GIs. While India has witnessed substantial growth in GI registrations, the number of authorised users remains disproportionately low. This paper critically examines the concept, legal framework, and practical challenges relating to authorised users under the Geographical Indications of Goods (Registration and Protection) Act, 1999, with a focused case study on Muga Silk of Assam. It argues that the under-utilisation of AU registration undermines the objectives of GI protection and proposes reforms to enhance inclusivity, enforcement, and economic impact.

AI.tldr: 印度地理标志(GI)制度的有效性高度依赖"授权用户"的参与，但尽管GI注册数量大幅增长，授权用户数量仍然不成比例地偏低。本文通过阿萨姆姆加丝绸的案例研究，分析了授权用户的概念、法律框架和实践挑战，认为AU注册不足损害了GI保护目标，并提出了增强包容性、执行力和经济影响的改革建议。
AI.research_question: 为什么印度地理标志制度中的授权用户注册数量远低于地理标志注册数量？授权用户制度存在哪些概念、法律和实践层面的挑战？如何改革授权用户制度以更好地实现地理标志保护的目标？
AI.motivation: 印度地理标志注册数量显著增长，但授权用户数量却不成比例地偏低，这种不平衡可能削弱地理标志制度的有效性。授权用户是地理标志制度的关键参与者，他们的参与不足会影响地理标志的执行、经济影响和包容性发展目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地理标志保护理论、集体知识产权理论、包容性发展理论、制度经济学理论。重点探讨地理标志作为集体权利的性质，以及授权用户在实现地理标志经济和社会价值中的关键作用。
AI.method: 法律文本分析、案例研究法（以阿萨姆姆加丝绸为具体案例）、比较分析法。通过分析《1999年商品地理标志（注册和保护）法》及相关法规，结合姆加丝绸的实际案例，识别授权用户制度的问题。
AI.findings: 1. 授权用户概念定义模糊，法律框架不完善；2. 注册程序复杂且成本高昂；3. 小生产者和传统工匠难以满足注册要求；4. 缺乏有效的执行机制；5. 授权用户数量不足导致地理标志的经济潜力未能充分发挥；6. 姆加丝绸案例显示授权用户制度未能惠及传统生产者。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对地理标志作为集体权利实现机制的理解；2. 提出了授权用户制度在连接法律保护与实际经济价值创造中的理论框架；3. 拓展了包容性知识产权制度的理论视角；4. 为发展中国家地理标志制度研究提供了新的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出简化授权用户注册程序的改革建议；2. 建议降低注册门槛以包容小生产者；3. 提出加强执行机制的具体措施；4. 为政策制定者提供增强地理标志制度包容性和有效性的实践指南；5. 为其他发展中国家地理标志制度改革提供借鉴。

title: Ayn Rand and Kingfisher on Zero-Carbon Bombs and a Sustainable Future
affiliations: Phenikaa University

detail.title: Ayn Rand and Kingfisher on Zero-Carbon Bombs and a Sustainable Future
detail.abstract: This piece imagines a fictional dialogue between Rand and Kingfisher, a philosopher-bird, centering on Rand’s key assumptions in the context of climate change, biodiversity loss, and environmental crises.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文通过虚构的哲学家-鸟类Kingfisher与Rand的对话，探讨Rand在气候变化、生物多样性丧失和环境危机背景下的核心假设。
AI.research_question: Rand的核心假设在当代环境危机背景下是否仍然成立？这些假设如何影响我们对气候变化和生物多样性丧失的理解和应对？
AI.motivation: 随着全球环境危机日益严峻，需要重新审视传统哲学假设在当代环境挑战中的适用性。Rand的哲学思想在环境伦理领域具有重要影响，但其假设在气候变化等新问题背景下需要批判性反思。
AI.theoretical_framework: Rand的客观主义哲学、环境伦理学、气候变化理论、生物多样性保护理论、对话哲学方法
AI.method: 虚构对话方法、哲学思辨分析、假设检验、跨学科理论整合
AI.findings: Rand的某些核心假设在环境危机背景下存在局限性；需要重新思考个体主义与集体责任的关系；环境伦理需要更复杂的理论框架来应对全球性生态挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了环境危机背景下的哲学对话方法；拓展了Rand哲学在生态领域的应用与批判；提出了适应环境挑战的新伦理框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为环境政策制定提供哲学基础；促进跨学科的环境问题讨论；启发更有效的环境保护行动策略。

title: Foreign Ownership and Environmental Performance Under the EU Emissions Trading System
affiliations: Sapienza University of Rome, Sapienza University of Rome, Second University of Naples, Sapienza University of Rome and Sapienza University of Rome

detail.title: Foreign Ownership and Environmental Performance Under the EU Emissions Trading System

declarations.funderStatement: This work was funded by the European Union – Next Generation EU, Mission 4, Component 1, under PRIN 2022, CUP B53D23010080006.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the environmental consequences of foreign acquisitions in a highly regulated setting, focusing on plant-level outcomes in Italy under Phase III of the European Union Emissions Trading System (EU-ETS). Combining verified emissions data with ownership and financial information for 2013-2020, we identify causal effects using a staggered Difference-inDifferences approach with Generalized Propensity Score weighting. Our baseline results suggest that foreign acquisition has a statistically insignificant effect on total emissions, but leads to a substantial reduction in emission intensity, without significant changes in output. Importantly, we find that the environmental effects vary by the origin of the investor: acquisitions by firms from OECD or EU-ETS countries improve emission efficiency, whereas those from non-OECD or non-EU-ETS countries exhibit less favourable outcomes. These findings provide new evidence on the role of regulatory experience and technological capabilities in shaping the environmental impact of foreign investment, highlighting the importance of accounting for investor origin when assessing FDI's environmental consequences.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了在欧盟排放交易体系第三阶段下，外资收购对意大利工厂环境绩效的影响。研究发现外资收购对总排放量影响不显著，但显著降低了排放强度，且不改变产出。投资者来源是关键调节因素：来自OECD或EU-ETS国家的收购改善排放效率，而来自非OECD或非EU-ETS国家的收购效果较差。
AI.research_question: 外资收购在高度监管环境（欧盟排放交易体系第三阶段）下对工厂层面环境绩效（排放总量和排放强度）有何影响？投资者来源（OECD/EU-ETS vs. 非OECD/非EU-ETS）如何调节这种影响？
AI.motivation: 随着全球对外商直接投资环境影响的关注增加，特别是在气候变化背景下，需要理解外资收购在严格环境监管下的实际效果。现有研究对外资的环境影响结论不一，且较少考虑投资者来源国的监管经验和技术能力差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度理论（投资者来源国的监管经验差异）和技术能力理论（跨国公司的技术转移能力），探讨外资收购通过监管经验传递和技术转移影响环境绩效的机制。
AI.method: 采用交错双重差分法结合广义倾向得分加权，使用2013-202年意大利工厂层面的验证排放数据、所有权信息和财务数据，识别外资收购的因果效应。
AI.findings: 1. 外资收购对总排放量影响统计不显著；2. 显著降低排放强度（单位产出的排放量），且不改变产出水平；3. 投资者来源是关键：来自OECD或EU-ETS国家的收购改善排放效率，而来自非OECD或非EU-ETS国家的收购效果较差。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将投资者来源国的制度环境和技术能力纳入外资环境影响的解释框架；2. 区分了排放总量和排放强度的不同影响机制；3. 为制度理论在环境经济学中的应用提供新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供依据：在评估外资环境后果时需考虑投资者来源；2. 支持针对不同来源国投资者的差异化环境监管政策；3. 为企业跨国并购的环境管理提供参考。

title: orGAN: Bridging Synthetic and Real Data for Surgical AI via Consistent Image–Label Generation
affiliations: University of Tokyo - The University of Tokyo, University of Tokyo and University of Tokyo

detail.title: orGAN: Bridging Synthetic and Real Data for Surgical AI via Consistent Image–Label Generation
detail.abstract: \textbf{Background and Objective:} Deep learning in medical imaging faces challenges including restricted data diversity, ethical constraints, high data acquisition costs, and limited accurate annotations. Accurately identifying and localizing bleeding sources during surgery is especially difficult due to scarce, well-annotated, realistic datasets. We propose orGAN, a framework for generating realistic, annotated synthetic surgical images of bleeding scenarios to mitigate these limitations. \textbf{Methods:} The orGAN pipeline uses an enhanced StyleGAN3 architecture tailored to silicone-based “mimicking organs” that emulate tissue properties. The system synthesizes bleeding images with specified bleeding coordinates and simultaneously extracts coordinates and masks to provide artifact-free supervision signals. An inpainting network refines images, and Bleeding Alert Map (BAM) models are trained on a balanced 1:1 dataset blending orGAN synthetic data with “mimicking organ” images. The software is implemented as a modular, reproducible pipeline with clear interfaces for downstream training. \textbf{Results:} The enhanced StyleGAN3 achieved an Inception Score increase of 2.24, and the inpainting network maintained a mean SSIM of 0.98. BAM trained on the blended dataset reached 90\% image-level bleeding detection accuracy and up to 99\% frame-level accuracy in both ex-vivo and in-vivo evaluations, outperforming models trained solely on real or solely on synthetic data. \textbf{Conclusions:} orGAN provides an ethical and economical approach to generating annotated surgical datasets, coupling high-fidelity image synthesis with automatic supervision (coordinates and masks). The modular design enables reuse beyond one-off experiments and supports bleeding-localization workflows and broader AI applications in surgery.

AI.tldr: orGAN框架使用增强的StyleGAN3生成带标注的合成手术出血图像，通过混合合成与真实数据训练出血检测模型，在内外评估中达到90-99%的检测准确率。
AI.research_question: 如何生成高质量、带标注的合成手术出血图像来解决医学影像中数据稀缺和标注困难的问题？
AI.motivation: 医学影像深度学习面临数据多样性受限、伦理约束、数据获取成本高、准确标注有限等挑战，特别是在手术中准确识别和定位出血源因缺乏真实、标注良好的数据集而尤为困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生成对抗网络（GAN）理论，特别是StyleGAN3架构，结合图像合成、坐标提取和图像修复技术。
AI.method: 使用增强的StyleGAN3架构针对硅基"模拟器官"生成出血图像，同时提取坐标和掩码；通过修复网络精炼图像；在1:1混合合成与真实数据上训练出血警报图（BAM）模型。
AI.findings: 增强的StyleGAN3的Inception Score提高了2.24，修复网络保持平均SSIM为0.98；在混合数据集上训练的BAM在图像级出血检测准确率达到90%，帧级准确率高达99%，优于仅用真实或合成数据训练的模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个结合高保真图像合成与自动监督（坐标和掩码）的伦理经济方法；展示了混合合成与真实数据训练的有效性；为手术AI应用提供了可复用的模块化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了生成标注手术数据集的实用工具；支持出血定位工作流程；降低了数据获取成本和伦理风险；实现了优于传统方法的检测性能；框架设计支持下游训练和更广泛的手术AI应用。

title: Acquisition Reporting Complexity and Post-acquisition Misreporting
affiliations: University of Louisville, University of Louisiana Monroe and University of Tennessee, Haslam College of Business, Accounting and Information Management

detail.title: Acquisition Reporting Complexity and Post-acquisition Misreporting
detail.abstract: Mergers and acquisitions (M&As) are significant corporate events offering many benefits to firms. However, because they are complex, they can lead to post-acquisition financial reporting problems. We focus on two components of acquisition reporting complexity – acquisition accounting complexity, which is related to the recording of the M&A transaction following Accounting Standards Codification 805 Business Combinations, and acquisition integration complexity, which results from the reporting of new transactions in the post-acquisition integration period. We find that acquisition reporting complexity increases the likelihood of post-acquisition misreporting but, importantly, this misreporting is driven by acquisition integration complexity rather than acquisition accounting complexity. We further find that acquisition reporting complexity, particularly acquisition integration complexity, increases the amount of time taken to discover post-acquisition misstatements as well as their magnitude.

AI.tldr: 研究发现并购报告复杂性会增加并购后错报的可能性，但这种错报主要由并购整合复杂性而非并购会计复杂性驱动，且整合复杂性还会延长错报发现时间和增加错报规模。
AI.research_question: 并购报告复杂性（包括并购会计复杂性和并购整合复杂性）如何影响并购后财务错报的可能性、发现时间和规模？
AI.motivation: 并购作为重要的公司事件虽然带来许多好处，但由于其复杂性可能导致并购后财务报告问题，需要研究不同复杂性维度对财务报告质量的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于并购报告复杂性理论，区分并购会计复杂性（遵循ASC 805会计准则）和并购整合复杂性（并购后整合期新交易报告）两个维度。
AI.method: 实证研究方法，分析并购报告复杂性对错报可能性、发现时间和规模的影响，区分会计复杂性和整合复杂性的不同作用。
AI.findings: 1. 并购报告复杂性增加并购后错报可能性；2. 错报主要由并购整合复杂性驱动，而非并购会计复杂性；3. 并购整合复杂性延长错报发现时间并增加错报规模。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：区分并购报告复杂性的两个维度，揭示整合复杂性比会计复杂性对财务报告质量影响更大，深化对并购后财务报告问题的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践意义：提醒公司和管理者特别关注并购整合期的报告复杂性，加强整合期内部控制，监管机构应加强对并购整合期财务报告的监督。

title: Does the Presence of Multinationals Help Domestic Firms to Comply with Environmental Regulations? Evidence from Italy
affiliations: Sapienza University of Rome, Sapienza University of Rome, Second University of Naples, Sapienza University of Rome and Sapienza University of Rome

detail.title: Does the Presence of Multinationals Help Domestic Firms to Comply with Environmental Regulations? Evidence from Italy

declarations.funderStatement: This work was funded by the European Union – Next Generation EU, Mission 4, Component 1, under PRIN 2022, CUP B53D23010080006.

detail.abstract: Countries worldwide implement various policy instruments to mitigate and prevent environmental degradation. Within the European Union, the Emissions Trading Scheme (ETS) is a central mechanism aimed at reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions. This paper investigates how the presence of foreign-owned firms influences the environmental performance of domestic firms subject to the ETS, particularly those operating in power and heat generation and energy-intensive sectors. Using plant-level data from Italy for the period 2013-2020-corresponding to the third phase of the EU ETS-we find that the presence of foreign-owned suppliers facilitates compliance by domestic plants, leading to a reduction in emission intensity (measured as emissions per unit of output). In contrast, the presence of foreign-owned customers and competitors appears to have an adverse effect, although the influence of the foreign competition is less statistically robust.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，在欧盟碳排放交易体系（ETS）下，外资供应商的存在有助于国内企业降低排放强度，而外资客户和竞争对手则产生负面影响，但外资竞争的影响统计显著性较弱。
AI.research_question: 外资企业的存在如何影响受欧盟碳排放交易体系（ETS）约束的国内企业的环境绩效？
AI.motivation: 各国实施各种政策工具来缓解和防止环境退化，欧盟碳排放交易体系是减少温室气体排放的核心机制。研究外资企业在ETS框架下对国内企业环境绩效的影响，有助于理解跨国企业在环境政策实施中的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于欧盟碳排放交易体系（ETS）政策框架，结合外资企业通过供应链关系（供应商、客户）和市场竞争对国内企业环境绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用意大利2013-2020年（欧盟ETS第三阶段）的工厂级数据进行分析，研究外资供应商、客户和竞争对手对国内工厂排放强度（单位产出排放量）的影响。
AI.findings: 外资供应商的存在有助于国内工厂遵守ETS规定，降低排放强度；而外资客户和竞争对手则产生负面影响，但外资竞争的影响统计显著性较弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了环境政策与跨国企业互动关系的理论理解，揭示了外资企业通过不同渠道（供应链vs市场竞争）对国内企业环境绩效的异质性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计更有效的环境政策提供依据，建议考虑外资企业在供应链中的积极作用，同时关注外资客户和竞争可能带来的负面环境效应。

title: Collective Bargaining Centralisation Against All Odds? The Italian Telecommunications Industry after Market Liberalization

detail.title: Collective Bargaining Centralisation Against All Odds? The Italian Telecommunications Industry after Market Liberalization
