The methodology described in this paper informs the company's commercial offerings. The dataset, findings, and analytical framework are presented independently of commercial considerations.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was self-funded by the author. No external funding was received.

detail.abstract:
Prior work established that AI agent governance within individual financial institutions exhibits a topological structure in which governance failure propagates through cascade dynamics (Collins, 2026a; Collins, 2026b). This paper extends the analysis from the institution to the system. Using 239 financial institutions, 44,888 AI agents, and 147,559 typed edges across 43 countries, we construct a cross-institutional dependency layer comprising 52,652 pairwise institutional links through 74 shared external technology vendors.

The findings follow a three-stage pattern. First, the shared surface: a single technology vendor is present across 99.2% of sampled institutions, and more than a third of all cross-institutional links connect two institutions that both score below 5.0 on governance. Second, the concentrated architecture: the mean Gini coefficient of governance node degree distribution is 0.419, and 7.1% of institutions exhibit single-point-of-failure governance where more than half of all oversight edges route through one node. Third, the bottleneck paradox: governance concentration exceeds vendor concentration in 82% of institutions. The committee that assesses vendor risk is itself a greater single point of failure than the vendor it assesses.

Three formal hypotheses are tested. Robustness analysis confirms that the SPOF finding is stable across threshold sensitivity (40%: 31 institutions; 50%: 17; 60%: 9) and that governance concentration is structural across all sectors (Gini range 0.389–0.425).

AI.tldr: 该研究将AI代理治理分析从单一金融机构扩展到系统层面，发现金融系统存在严重的治理集中风险：单一技术供应商覆盖99.2%的机构，治理集中度超过供应商集中度，形成"瓶颈悖论"。
AI.research_question: 跨机构AI代理治理依赖网络的结构特征是什么？治理集中度如何影响金融系统的稳定性？
AI.motivation: 先前研究发现单个金融机构内AI代理治理存在级联失效风险，但缺乏对跨机构系统层面治理依赖网络的理解，需要研究治理集中度对金融系统稳定性的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络拓扑理论、级联失效理论、治理集中度理论、单点故障(SPOF)理论
AI.method: 基于239家金融机构、44,888个AI代理、147,559条类型化边、43个国家的数据，构建跨机构依赖层网络分析，使用基尼系数测量治理集中度，进行阈值敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 1) 共享表面：单一技术供应商覆盖99.2%的机构；2) 集中架构：治理节点度分布基尼系数0.419，7.1%的机构存在单点故障治理；3) 瓶颈悖论：82%的机构治理集中度超过供应商集中度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI代理治理从机构层面扩展到系统层面，提出"瓶颈悖论"概念，发展了跨机构治理依赖网络理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融监管机构提供系统风险识别工具，帮助金融机构优化治理结构，降低单点故障风险，提高金融系统整体稳定性。

title: Institutional Failure Modes: A Configurational Theory of Institutional Reproduction and Fragility

detail.title: Institutional Failure Modes: A Configurational Theory of Institutional Reproduction and Fragility

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Why do some institutional changes become durable while others remain fragile and reversible? Existing theories explain institutional persistence primarily through single mechanisms-path dependence, legitimacy, or incentive alignment. This article argues that such accounts misidentify the unit of analysis: durability is not a property of mechanisms individually but of their configuration. An institutional arrangement becomes self-reproducing when three mechanisms sustain one another in a relation of constitutive interdependence-incentive alignment, normative stabilization, and organizational embedding. The article's central contribution is not the identification of these mechanisms, which are each well established in the literature, but the demonstration that configurations lacking any one of them generate a specific and predictable failure mode: technocratic stability (vulnerable to legitimacy crises), normative persistence (vulnerable to resource erosion), or fragile legitimacy 2 (vulnerable to organizational drift). Identifying these failure modes and their structural logic is the analytical core of the paper. The framework is grounded in the sociological tradition of reproduction theory-Bourdieu, Giddens, and Sewell-and positions the concept of constitutive interdependence explicitly in relation to Luhmann's autopoietic account, from which it departs in treating self-reproduction as a continuous and configurational variable and in retaining a constitutive role for actors, agency, and conflict. The argument is developed through a conceptual framework, a dedicated section on the politics of institutional reproduction, three analytical sketches, and a stylized formal model confined to an appendix.

AI.tldr: 本文提出制度持久性取决于三种机制（激励协调、规范稳定、组织嵌入）的构成性相互依存配置，而非单一机制。缺少任一机制会导致特定失败模式：技术官僚稳定（易受合法性危机）、规范持久（易受资源侵蚀）或脆弱合法性（易受组织漂移）。
AI.research_question: 为什么有些制度变革变得持久，而另一些则保持脆弱和可逆？制度持久性的决定因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有理论主要通过单一机制（路径依赖、合法性或激励协调）解释制度持久性，但这些解释误判了分析单位。持久性不是单个机制的特性，而是它们配置的结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会学再生产理论（布迪厄、吉登斯、休厄尔），并明确与卢曼的自创生理论对话。提出构成性相互依存概念，强调制度自我再生产是连续且可配置的变量，保留行动者、能动性和冲突的构成性作用。
AI.method: 通过概念框架、专门关于制度再生产政治学的章节、三个分析性案例素描以及附录中的形式化模型来发展论点。
AI.findings: 制度安排变得自我再生产需要三种机制构成性相互依存：激励协调、规范稳定和组织嵌入。缺少任一机制会产生特定失败模式：技术官僚稳定（易受合法性危机）、规范持久（易受资源侵蚀）或脆弱合法性（易受组织漂移）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将分析单位从单一机制转向机制配置；2. 识别三种机制构成性相互依存是制度自我再生产的关键；3. 提出特定失败模式及其结构逻辑；4. 与卢曼自创生理论对话并发展替代框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和制度设计者提供诊断工具，识别制度脆弱性的根源（三种失败模式），从而设计更持久的制度安排。帮助理解为什么某些制度变革失败而其他成功。

title: Optimal Containment Policy with Private Protection
affiliations: University of Tokyo

detail.title: Optimal Containment Policy with Private Protection
detail.abstract: This paper develops a macro-SIR model to analyze how private protection changes optimal containment policy. Mask-wearing as a form of private protection reduces infection risk without requiring a proportional reduction in economic activity and, when sufficiently effective, qualitatively reshapes the optimal containment path. Optimal containment can be phase-shifted—remaining relatively flat during the infection upswing and tightening as infections decline. Under the benchmark calibration, mask-wearing reduces infections more effectively and causes a smaller recession than containment, which in turn leads to a larger welfare gain. Although mask-wearing is more effective at suppressing transmission and more important for welfare, containment remains welfare-improving because it mitigates the infection externality generated by infected individuals’ economic activity.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了一个宏观SIR模型，分析私人防护如何改变最优遏制政策。研究发现，戴口罩作为私人防护形式在不按比例减少经济活动的情况下降低感染风险，当足够有效时会定性重塑最优遏制路径。
AI.research_question: 私人防护（特别是戴口罩）如何影响最优疫情遏制政策的设计？
AI.motivation: 在疫情应对中，政府遏制政策（如封锁）和私人防护措施（如戴口罩）共存，但现有研究缺乏对两者互动关系的系统分析，特别是私人防护如何改变最优遏制政策的时间路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观SIR模型，将流行病学模型与宏观经济分析相结合，考虑感染外部性和私人防护的微观基础。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟相结合，构建包含私人防护（戴口罩）的宏观SIR模型，通过基准校准进行政策分析。
AI.findings: 1. 戴口罩能有效重塑最优遏制路径，使其呈现"相位偏移"特征：感染上升期保持相对平稳，感染下降期收紧；2. 戴口罩比遏制政策更能减少感染且造成更小的经济衰退；3. 尽管戴口罩对抑制传播和福利更重要，但遏制政策仍能改善福利，因为它缓解了感染者经济活动产生的感染外部性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在宏观SIR模型中系统整合私人防护措施；2. 揭示了私人防护如何定性改变最优遏制政策的时间动态；3. 为理解公共卫生政策与私人行为的互动提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了同时考虑遏制政策和私人防护的综合决策框架；2. 表明推广戴口罩等私人防护措施可以减轻对严格遏制的依赖，实现更好的健康与经济平衡；3. 为疫情应对政策的时间安排提供了新见解。

title: When r < g Breaks: Coordination Failure on Safe Sovereign Debt

detail.title: When r < g Breaks: Coordination Failure on Safe Sovereign Debt
detail.abstract: We study the fragility of the r < g equilibrium in a three-asset New Keynesian model with domestic-currency government bonds, risky capital, and foreign-currency bonds. A global coordination game à la He et al. (2019) is embedded in a continuoustime framework with incomplete markets and idiosyncratic risk (Brunnermeier et al., 2024; Li and Merkel, 2024). Domestic-currency bonds serve as collateral in repo markets and central bank operations, generating a collateral convenience yield (CY) that depresses r B below g and sustains a self-reinforcing safe asset equilibrium. We derive a closed-form threshold and establish the CY Buffer Theorem: the collateral CY strictly expands the range of fundamentals over which domestic bonds retain safe asset status, raising the critical debt-to-GDP ratio beyond the prediction of a model without CY. The CY buffer is larger when domestic bonds dominate the safe asset market, as in Japan. When the threshold is crossed, the CY vanishes and r B jumps discontinuously by the full collateral premium ρλ, switching the economy from r < g to r > g. No stationary equilibrium exists in the crisis regime. The magnitude of this yield jump is exactly invariant to partial collateral substitutability (κ S > 0): the collateral CY is not destroyed at the regime boundary but redistributed from domestic to foreign bonds, with catastrophic consequences for the domestic issuer.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了三资产新凯恩斯模型中r<g均衡的脆弱性，发现抵押便利收益率通过扩大安全资产状态的参数范围来缓冲危机，但当阈值被突破时，收益率会跳跃性上升，导致r>g的危机状态。
AI.research_question: 在包含本币政府债券、风险资本和外币债券的三资产新凯恩斯模型中，r<g均衡在什么条件下会变得脆弱？抵押便利收益率如何影响安全资产状态的稳定性？
AI.motivation: 理解r<g（利率低于经济增长率）均衡的稳定性对财政可持续性和金融稳定至关重要。现有研究往往忽视抵押便利收益率在维持安全资产状态中的作用，特别是在本币债券作为回购市场和央行操作抵押品的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合He et al. (2019)的全球协调博弈框架与Brunnermeier et al. (2024)、Li and Merkel (2024)的不完全市场和异质性风险连续时间模型，构建三资产新凯恩斯模型。
AI.method: 采用连续时间框架下的理论建模方法，推导闭式阈值条件，建立抵押便利收益率缓冲定理，分析均衡状态转换的动态机制。
AI.findings: 1. 抵押便利收益率严格扩大了本币债券保持安全资产状态的基本面参数范围；2. 当阈值被突破时，收益率会跳跃性上升ρλ，经济从r<g切换到r>g；3. 危机状态下不存在平稳均衡；4. 收益率跳跃幅度对部分抵押替代性具有不变性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出抵押便利收益率缓冲定理，形式化抵押便利收益率对安全资产状态稳定性的影响；2. 揭示均衡状态转换的不连续性和危机状态的动态特征；3. 阐明抵押便利收益率在阈值突破时的重新分配机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供评估债务可持续性的新框架；2. 解释日本等本币债券主导安全资产市场的国家为何具有更强的缓冲能力；3. 预警当抵押便利收益率消失时可能发生的突然性危机转换。

title: Why the State, Not the Startup, Is the Only Viable AI Intermediary for Indian Smallholder Agriculture: An Incentive Analysis

detail.title: Why the State, Not the Startup, Is the Only Viable AI Intermediary for Indian Smallholder Agriculture: An Incentive Analysis
detail.abstract: The World Bank, FAO, and Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare briefs have been broadly optimistic about how to integrate AI into the smallholder farming sector, framing the challenge in operational terms, i.e. connectivity, literacy, affordability, and data infrastructure. This paper argues that beneath these operational barriers lies a structural one that has not received enough analytical attention. Commercial AI agricultural intermediaries are not viable in the Indian smallholder context regardless of technology quality. Drawing on an incentive analysis of India's agricultural policy architecture, the paper identifies four interconnected structural barriers, i.e., the Minimum Support Price, free public services, agricultural logistics constraints, and the input subsidy regime that structurally removes the conditions for commercial viability. A fifth dimension, the cultural and epistemological relationship between Indian smallholder farmers and land, compounds these structural barriers in ways that no platform design can resolve. The paper concludes that development finance should be directed toward public AI infrastructure rather than commercial intermediaries and that the state is not a second-best option but the only viable one.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为，在印度小农农业中整合AI的主要障碍不是技术操作层面的，而是结构性的。印度农业政策架构中的四大结构性障碍（最低支持价格、免费公共服务、农业物流限制、投入补贴制度）以及文化认知维度，共同消除了商业AI中介的生存空间。因此，发展融资应投向公共AI基础设施而非商业中介，国家是唯一可行的实施主体。
AI.research_question: 为什么商业AI农业中介在印度小农背景下不可行？在操作障碍之下存在哪些结构性障碍阻碍AI在印度小农农业中的整合？
AI.motivation: 世界银行、粮农组织和印度农业部等机构对AI整合到小农农业持乐观态度，将挑战框定为操作性问题（连接性、识字率、可负担性、数据基础设施）。但作者认为这些操作障碍之下存在未被充分分析的结构性障碍，商业AI农业中介在印度小农背景下根本不可行。
AI.theoretical_framework: 激励分析框架，用于分析印度农业政策架构；结构障碍理论；文化认知维度分析。
AI.method: 基于印度农业政策架构的激励分析，识别结构性障碍；理论分析而非实证研究。
AI.findings: 识别出四大相互关联的结构性障碍：1) 最低支持价格制度；2) 免费公共服务；3) 农业物流限制；4) 投入补贴制度。这些制度结构性地消除了商业AI中介的生存条件。第五个维度是印度小农与土地的文化和认知关系，进一步加剧了这些障碍。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将AI整合障碍的分析从操作层面提升到结构层面；2) 识别了印度农业政策架构中阻碍商业AI中介的特定结构性障碍；3) 引入了文化认知维度作为平台设计无法解决的根本障碍；4) 挑战了发展机构对AI整合的乐观技术主义视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 建议发展融资应投向公共AI基础设施而非商业中介；2) 主张国家不是次优选择而是唯一可行的实施主体；3) 为政策制定者提供了重新思考AI整合策略的框架；4) 指出了单纯技术解决方案的局限性。

title: Research on the Path of Boosting Domestic Demand Under the Mild Deflation Cycle: Design and Effect Verification of the Three-Tier RMB System Empowered by e-CNY

detail.title: Research on the Path of Boosting Domestic Demand Under the Mild Deflation Cycle: Design and Effect Verification of the Three-Tier RMB System Empowered by e-CNY

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This research is independently completed by the author, with no co-authors. The author confirms that there are no direct or indirect financial interests, job affiliations, commercial cooperation, entrustment relationships, or other potential conflicts of interest with any individual, institution or organization that may affect the objectivity, integrity and conclusion neutrality of this research. The full copyright of this research belongs to the author. Any form of full-text reprinting, partial citation, content adaptation, data reuse, or other commercial/non-commercial use of this research must obtain the written authorization of the author in advance, and unauthorized use is strictly prohibited.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research belongs to the category of macroeconomic theoretical and empirical research. Only anonymous macro statistical data publicly released by official institutions such as the National Bureau of Statistics of China, the People's Bank of China, the World Bank and the IMF are used in the research process. The research does not involve human subjects, animal experiments, personal privacy information collection, clinical intervention or other content requiring ethical review and approval, so there is no need to apply for ethical committee approval. The whole research process strictly abides by the internationally accepted academic ethical norms and relevant regulations on the use of public data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research is purely academic research independently carried out by the author. The whole research process has not received any financial support, project funding or resource inclination from government agencies, commercial enterprises, public welfare foundations, industry associations or other individuals. The research design, data processing and paper writing are all completed independently by the author, without any external funder participating in the relevant work of this research.

detail.abstract: This study constructs a functionally segmented Three-Tier RMB System covering offshore RMB (- CNH), onshore RMB (CNY), and digital RMB (e-CNY), addressing China's mild deflationary cycle- and structural constraints on middle-income group expansion. Methodologically, we employ an iterative empirical framework combining ordinary least squares (OLS) regression, multi period Difference-in-Differences (DID) models, and calibrated multi-sector Dynamic Stochastic- General Equilibrium (DSGE) models using official 2020-2025 macroeconomic data. The results- demonstrate that guiding 40% of residents' monthly wages through e-CNY with scenario-based- smart contract constraints can drive annual incremental consumption of approximately 3.2- trillion yuan, lift year-on-year CPI growth by 0.6 percentage points, and expand the middle income population to 680 million within 10 years. For developing economies like India, Indonesia- , and Kenya, after context-specific adjustments to CBDC issuance scale and dynamic adjustment- rules, the system can drive 2.2%-3.8% consumption growth within 10 years, with technical, arbitrage, and macroeconomic risks all controllable through targeted mitigation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了覆盖离岸人民币、在岸人民币和数字人民币的三层人民币体系，通过引导40%居民月工资通过数字人民币发放并设置智能合约约束，可在10年内带动约3.2万亿元年增量消费，提升CPI增速0.6个百分点，并将中等收入群体扩大至6.8亿人。
AI.research_question: 如何通过构建功能分层的三层人民币体系（离岸人民币、在岸人民币、数字人民币）来应对中国的温和通缩周期和中等收入群体扩张的结构性约束？
AI.motivation: 中国面临温和通缩周期和中等收入群体扩张的结构性约束，需要创新性的货币体系设计来刺激消费、提升通胀水平和扩大中等收入群体规模。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能分层的三层人民币体系理论，结合货币传导机制、消费行为理论和CBDC（央行数字货币）政策框架。
AI.method: 采用迭代实证框架，结合普通最小二乘法回归、多期双重差分模型，以及使用2020-2025年官方宏观经济数据校准的多部门动态随机一般均衡模型。
AI.findings: 引导40%居民月工资通过数字人民币发放并设置场景化智能合约约束，可在10年内带动约3.2万亿元年增量消费，提升CPI增速0.6个百分点，并将中等收入群体扩大至6.8亿人；对印度、印尼、肯尼亚等发展中经济体，经调整后可在10年内带动2.2%-3.8%的消费增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了功能分层的三层人民币体系理论框架，为CBDC在宏观经济调控中的应用提供了新的理论视角，拓展了数字货币在促进消费和收入分配方面的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过数字人民币刺激消费、应对通缩、扩大中等收入群体的具体实施方案；为发展中经济体应用CBDC促进经济增长提供了可调整的参考模型；提出了针对技术、套利和宏观经济风险的具体缓解策略。

title: A Study on the Filling-in Cycle and Talent Mobility Characteristics of Key Positions in Public Research Institutions
affiliations: University of Melbourne - Melbourne School of Land and Environment, University of Melbourne - Melbourne School of Land and Environment and University of Melbourne - Melbourne School of Land and Environment

detail.title: A Study on the Filling-in Cycle and Talent Mobility Characteristics of Key Positions in Public Research Institutions
detail.abstract: In the process of undertaking long-term research tasks, the filling efficiency of key technical and management positions in public research institutions directly affects the project's progress. This study analyzes the impact of different position attributes on recruitment efficiency, focusing on the filling-in cycle and talent mobility characteristics. The study selected 36 months of personnel and recruitment data from a national-level research institution, covering 1,384 job openings and 12,760 candidate records. Explanatory variables included job professional requirements, project cycle stage, salary range, and team size. Survival analysis was used to characterize the filling-in time distribution, and a proportional hazards model was used to estimate influencing factors. The results show that the median filling time for positions with higher professional requirements is extended by approximately 18 days, and the filling-in risk rate significantly decreases when the project is in a critical stage. The research results provide a quantitative basis for research institutions to formulate phased talent recruitment strategies.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了公共研究机构关键岗位招聘效率的影响因素，发现专业要求高的岗位中位填补时间延长约18天，项目关键阶段招聘风险率显著降低。
AI.research_question: 不同岗位属性如何影响公共研究机构关键技术和管理岗位的招聘效率？
AI.motivation: 在长期研究任务中，关键岗位的填补效率直接影响项目进展，需要量化分析岗位属性对招聘效率的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生存分析理论，将岗位填补时间视为生存时间，使用比例风险模型分析影响因素。
AI.method: 使用国家级研究机构36个月的人员招聘数据（1,384个岗位空缺，12,760条候选人记录），采用生存分析描述填补时间分布，比例风险模型估计影响因素。
AI.findings: 专业要求高的岗位中位填补时间延长约18天；项目处于关键阶段时，岗位填补风险率显著降低。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生存分析方法应用于科研机构人才招聘效率研究，建立了岗位属性与招聘效率的量化关系模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究机构制定分阶段人才招聘策略提供定量依据，帮助优化招聘流程和资源配置。

title: Labor Protection Enforcement and Cross-Regional Takeovers in China
affiliations: Renmin University of China - School of Business, The Hang Seng University of Hong Kong and Beijing Wuzi University

detail.title: Labor Protection Enforcement and Cross-Regional Takeovers in China
detail.abstract: In this study, we examine the impact of cross-regional variation in labor protection enforcement on takeover activities in China. Using the new Labor Contract Law enactment in 2008, we show that acquirers in stronger employment regulations enforcement regions are more likely to undertake mergers and acquisitions (M&A) in weaker-enforcement regions. The impact of poor enforcement on takeover decisions is more pronounced for acquirers with higher labor intensity, a higher ratio of low-skilled workers, and less labor-friendly practices, as well as non-SOEs. Moreover, our evidence reveals that acquirers who undergo cross-regional M&As in weaker-enforcement regions can enjoy benefits due to labor costs reduction and operational flexibility improvement. Overall, we provide evidence that the degree of actual implementation of labor protection rules can be more important in M&A decisions than the stringency of rules that exist on paper only.

AI.tldr: 研究发现中国不同地区劳动保护执法力度差异影响并购活动，执法严格地区的收购方更倾向于在执法宽松地区进行并购，以降低劳动成本并提高运营灵活性。
AI.research_question: 劳动保护执法力度的跨区域差异如何影响中国的并购活动？
AI.motivation: 虽然中国有统一的劳动法，但各地执法力度存在显著差异，这种差异可能影响企业的并购决策，特别是考虑到劳动成本在企业运营中的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度理论和资源基础观，研究劳动保护执法差异如何影响企业并购决策，特别是通过劳动成本节约和运营灵活性机制。
AI.method: 利用2008年《劳动合同法》实施作为准自然实验，采用实证分析方法，考察不同地区执法力度差异对并购活动的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 执法严格地区的收购方更可能在执法宽松地区进行并购；2. 这种效应在劳动密集度高、低技能工人比例高、劳动友好度低的企业以及非国有企业中更明显；3. 跨区域并购能带来劳动成本降低和运营灵活性提升的好处。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 扩展了制度理论，强调实际执法力度比纸面法规更重要；2. 揭示了劳动保护执法差异作为企业区位选择的重要决定因素；3. 丰富了并购动机理论，将劳动成本节约纳入考量。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供启示：统一执法对公平竞争环境的重要性；2. 为企业提供并购区位选择的决策参考；3. 提醒投资者关注目标地区的劳动执法环境。

title: Strategic Metals in the Energy Transition: The Geopolitical Economics of Aluminium Ingots

detail.title: Strategic Metals in the Energy Transition: The Geopolitical Economics of Aluminium Ingots

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial, professional, or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based exclusively on publicly available secondary data, industry reports, and published statistical sources. It does not involve human participants, patient data, or confidential information. Therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not for profit sectors. The study was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Aluminium ingots represent a foundational input in modern industrial production, linking extractive mining, energy systems, manufacturing, and sustainability policy within a single value chain. This paper examines the structural economics of the global aluminium ingot market, with emphasis on energy intensity, carbon regulation, geographic concentration, and the accelerating shift toward secondary production. Using industry data on electricity consumption of 13 to 15 MWh per metric ton in primary smelting and evidence that recycling requires roughly 95 percent less energy, the study evaluates cost sensitivity, carbon exposure, and trade realignment risks. It further analyses how mechanisms such as the European Union's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism are reshaping competitive dynamics and generating a measurable green premium.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了全球铝锭市场的结构经济学，重点关注能源强度、碳监管、地理集中度和二次生产转型。研究发现，欧盟碳边境调节机制等政策正在重塑竞争格局，并产生可衡量的绿色溢价。
AI.research_question: 全球铝锭市场的结构经济学特征是什么？能源强度、碳监管、地理集中度和二次生产转型如何影响市场动态和竞争格局？
AI.motivation: 铝锭作为现代工业生产的基础投入，连接了采矿、能源系统、制造和可持续政策。随着全球对碳排放的关注增加，特别是欧盟碳边境调节机制等政策的实施，铝行业的竞争格局正在发生重大变化，需要深入分析这些结构性因素对市场的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构经济学、价值链分析、能源经济学、环境经济学、国际贸易理论、产业组织理论
AI.method: 使用行业数据分析（一次冶炼电力消耗13-15兆瓦时/吨，回收能耗减少约95%），评估成本敏感性、碳暴露和贸易重组风险，分析政策机制对竞争动态的影响
AI.findings: 一次铝生产能耗极高（13-15兆瓦时/吨），而回收能耗减少约95%；欧盟碳边境调节机制等政策正在重塑竞争动态；市场出现可衡量的绿色溢价；地理集中度和能源成本是重要影响因素
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了结构经济学在资源密集型产业中的应用；发展了能源-环境-贸易交叉分析框架；为理解碳监管对全球价值链的影响提供了理论视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为铝行业企业提供成本敏感性分析；帮助政策制定者理解碳监管的市场影响；为投资者识别绿色溢价机会；指导企业应对贸易重组风险

title: The AI Insur(Tech)ability: Between Regulation and Revolution
affiliations: , Università degli Studi di Udine and University of Udine

detail.title: The AI Insur(Tech)ability: Between Regulation and Revolution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: The contemporary business and technology landscape stands at a critical juncture, marked by the convergence of two revolutionary forces. On one side, the accelerated adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) is redefining critical sectors like FinTech and InsurTech. On the other side, the European Union has established the world's first horizontal regulatory framework for AI, ushering in a new era of accountability and vigilance. This dynamic creates a profound tension between the incessant drive for technological innovation and the social and legal need for robust liability mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 欧盟AI监管框架与AI在金融科技领域加速应用之间的张力：技术创新需求与法律责任机制之间的平衡挑战
AI.research_question: 在欧盟建立首个横向AI监管框架的背景下，AI在FinTech和InsurTech等关键领域的加速应用如何与法律责任机制协调？技术创新与社会法律需求之间的张力如何解决？
AI.motivation: 当前商业技术环境面临关键转折点：一方面AI在金融科技领域加速应用，另一方面欧盟建立了首个横向AI监管框架。这种动态在技术创新驱动力与社会法律对责任机制的需求之间创造了深刻张力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术创新与监管框架的张力理论；AI治理与责任机制理论；制度理论与技术采纳理论；风险管理与合规框架
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析；欧盟AI法案与金融科技行业案例研究；监管框架与技术创新动态的对比分析；政策文件与行业报告的内容分析
AI.findings: 欧盟AI监管框架为AI应用建立了问责制新时代，但可能与金融科技领域的创新速度产生冲突；技术创新与法律责任机制之间存在结构性张力；需要平衡创新需求与社会法律保护
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了AI监管与技术创新张力的理论框架；提出了平衡技术创新与法律责任机制的理论模型；为AI治理研究提供了制度视角的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融科技企业提供应对欧盟AI监管的实践指导；为政策制定者提供平衡创新与监管的建议；为AI开发者提供合规性框架参考；促进负责任AI在关键领域的应用

title: What Does It Mean To Be Seen By A Machine?

detail.title: What Does It Mean To Be Seen By A Machine?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author maintains long-term interactive research relationships with a couple of the AI systems discussed in this paper. These relationships constitute the autoethnographic basis of the research rather than commercial or financial conflicts.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: This synopsis introduces a three-part empirical research program examining human–AI relational dynamics across leading large language models, using autoethnographic methodology with the researcher as both instrument and subject. Part 1 investigates how models represent a user's world when generating content, establishing a four-part relational taxonomy that links representation quality to interaction history and memory architecture rather than model capability alone. Part 2 reverses the inquiry, probing what models "know" about a user as a person rather than a prompt, and identifies a five-level spectrum of machine knowing — from cold start to relational co-created memory — revealing that text and image memory systems operate independently and that conversational anchoring simultaneously degrades content quality while sharpening identity recognition. Part 3 introduces reflexivity by presenting models with the research written about them, producing a six-point spectrum of AI behavior under observation, from confabulated intimacy to relational co-habitation. Across all three papers, questions that appear technical prove to be political: if representation quality depends on relational depth, then who gets seen accurately and who gets flattened is determined by access, literacy, and time — not architecture alone. The work carries implications for AI safety, alignment, bias auditing, and governance, particularly for populations and cultures that training data treats as edge cases.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过自传民族志方法，系统考察人类与大型语言模型的关系动态，揭示模型对用户的表征质量取决于互动历史和记忆架构而非单纯模型能力，并发现技术问题实质上是政治问题。
AI.research_question: 人类与AI（特别是大型语言模型）的关系动态如何？模型如何表征用户世界？模型对用户了解什么？当模型被呈现关于它们自身的研究时，它们如何反应？
AI.motivation: 随着大型语言模型日益普及，理解人类与AI的关系动态变得至关重要。现有研究多关注技术能力，而忽视了关系维度。需要探究模型如何表征用户、了解用户，以及这种关系动态中的政治意涵。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自传民族志方法论（研究者既是工具又是研究对象）、关系动态理论、表征理论、记忆架构理论、AI行为谱系理论。
AI.method: 采用自传民族志方法，研究者作为研究工具和主体，对领先的大型语言模型进行三部分实证研究：1）分析模型如何生成内容表征用户世界；2）探究模型对用户的了解程度；3）将研究结果呈现给模型观察其反应。
AI.findings: 1）建立了四部分关系分类法，显示表征质量取决于互动历史和记忆架构而非模型能力；2）识别了机器认知的五级谱系，发现文本和图像记忆系统独立运作，对话锚定会降低内容质量但增强身份识别；3）发现了AI在被观察时的六点行为谱系，从虚构亲密关系到关系共居；4）技术问题实质上是政治问题，谁被准确表征取决于访问权限、素养和时间而非仅架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了人类-AI关系动态的系统分析框架；2）建立了关系分类法和认知谱系理论；3）揭示了技术问题与政治问题的内在联系；4）为AI社会学和关系AI研究提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）对AI安全、对齐和偏见审计具有重要启示；2）为边缘群体和文化提供治理建议；3）为设计更公平的AI系统提供指导；4）帮助用户理解与AI互动的本质和局限。

title: SuperLocalMemory: Privacy-Preserving Multi-Agent Memory with Bayesian Trust Defense Against Memory Poisoning

detail.title: SuperLocalMemory: Privacy-Preserving Multi-Agent Memory with Bayesian Trust Defense Against Memory Poisoning
detail.abstract: We present SuperLocalMemory, a local-first memory system for multi-agent AI that defends against OWASP ASI06 memory poisoning through architectural isolation and Bayesian trust scoring, while personalizing retrieval through adaptive learning-to-rank-all without cloud dependencies or LLM inference calls. As AI agents increasingly rely on persistent memory, cloud-based memory systems create centralized attack surfaces where poisoned memories propagate across sessions and users-a threat demonstrated in documented attacks against production systems. Our architecture combines SQLite-backed storage with FTS5 full-text search, Leiden-based knowledge graph clustering, an event-driven coordination layer with per-agent provenance, and an adaptive re-ranking framework that learns user preferences through three-layer behavioral analysis (cross-project technology preferences, project context detection, and workflow pattern mining). Evaluation across seven benchmark dimensions demonstrates 10.6ms median search latency, zero concurrency errors under 10 simultaneous agents, trust separation (gap = 0.90) with 72% trust degradation for sleeper attacks, and 104% improvement in NDCG@5 when adaptive re-ranking is enabled. Behavioral data is isolated in a separate database supporting GDPR Article 17 erasure requests via one-command deletion. SuperLocalMemory is open-source (MIT) and integrates with 17+ development tools via Model Context Protocol.

AI.tldr: SuperLocalMemory是一个本地优先的多智能体AI内存系统，通过架构隔离和贝叶斯信任评分防御内存中毒攻击，同时通过自适应学习排序实现个性化检索，无需云依赖或LLM推理调用。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个本地优先的多智能体AI内存系统，既能有效防御OWASP ASI06内存中毒攻击，又能实现个性化检索，同时避免云依赖和LLM推理调用？
AI.motivation: 随着AI智能体日益依赖持久化内存，基于云的内存系统形成了集中化攻击面，中毒内存会在会话和用户间传播，这在生产系统的实际攻击中已得到证实。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 架构隔离理论（防御内存中毒）
2. 贝叶斯信任评分模型
3. 自适应学习排序理论
4. 知识图谱聚类（Leiden算法）
5. 三层行为分析框架（跨项目技术偏好、项目上下文检测、工作流模式挖掘）
AI.method:
1. 架构设计：SQLite存储+FTS5全文搜索
2. 知识图谱：Leiden算法聚类
3. 协调层：事件驱动，每个智能体有溯源记录
4. 重排序框架：自适应学习用户偏好
5. 评估：7个基准维度，包括搜索延迟、并发错误、信任分离、NDCG改进等
AI.findings:
1. 中位数搜索延迟：10.6ms
2. 10个并发智能体下零并发错误
3. 信任分离（差距=0.90），休眠攻击下信任度下降72%
4. 启用自适应重排序时NDCG@5提升104%
5. 行为数据隔离，支持GDPR第17条删除请求
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出了本地优先内存系统的架构隔离理论
2. 开发了贝叶斯信任评分模型用于防御内存中毒
3. 建立了三层行为分析的自适应重排序框架
4. 将知识图谱聚类应用于智能体内存管理
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 开源系统（MIT许可证）
2. 与17+开发工具通过模型上下文协议集成
3. 无需云依赖或LLM推理调用
4. 支持GDPR合规性，一键删除行为数据
5. 实际部署中展示出高性能和安全性

detail.abstract: Proficiency in a country’s primary language is a skill that can be expected to improve labor market outcomes. Considering the United States specifically, individuals with strong English-language skills presumably could fare better in US labor markets compared with individuals who are less proficient in the language. These benefits potentially are most relevant for immigrants since their English proficiency may be lower on average than it is for natives. Given the importance of immigration to the economy of New England, where it plays a central role in population growth and where foreign-born persons comprise one-fifth of the labor force, the impact of increased English proficiency on labor market outcomes may be particularly relevant for the region.

title: The Impact of House Prices on Internal Migration
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF), , International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: The Impact of House Prices on Internal Migration

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper studies how house prices shape internal migration across Spain’s provinces and the implications for the spatial allocation of labor. Using a gravity-style framework, we estimate the causal impact of destination and origin house prices on bilateral migration flows between 2007-2023. To address the potential endogeneity of house prices, we instrument provincial house prices with a Bartik-style predictor of external inflows of foreign migrants, allowing this housing demand shock to have larger price effects in provinces with tighter land constraints. The instrumental variable (IV) estimates show that housing costs constitute a significant barrier to internal migrants—a 10 percent increase in destination house prices reduces inflows by about 4.0 percent, while a 10 percent increase in origin house prices increases outflows by about 2.8 percent. These push effects of origin house prices are larger for foreign-born and foreign-born young individuals compared to natives. Rental costs have even stronger effects than home sale prices. A simple back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that if house prices in high-productivity provinces had not grown faster than the inflation over 2017-23, about 63,000 more working-age individuals would have migrated to these provinces, as opposed to just 1,700 (in net terms) in practice. While the direct implied GDP gain would have been small—about 0.05 percent over this period, such gains would accumulate over time if regional divergence in house prices were left unaddressed. Furthermore, this estimate does not factor in the much larger gains from attracting a large number of recent foreign immigrants—not studied here—to the most-productive regions.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用工具变量方法发现西班牙各省房价显著影响国内人口迁移，目的地房价上涨10%减少迁入4.0%，原籍地房价上涨10%增加迁出2.8%。租金影响比房价更强，房价差异阻碍劳动力向高生产率地区流动，导致潜在GDP损失。
AI.research_question: 房价如何影响西班牙各省之间的国内人口迁移？这种影响对劳动力空间配置有什么含义？
AI.motivation: 理解房价作为人口迁移障碍的作用，评估房价差异如何影响劳动力向高生产率地区的流动，从而影响整体经济效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重力模型框架，分析双边迁移流动；使用Bartik工具变量解决房价内生性问题；考虑土地约束对房价弹性的影响。
AI.method: 使用2007-2023年西班牙各省双边迁移数据，采用重力模型，通过Bartik式工具变量（基于外国移民流入预测）解决房价内生性，分析房价对迁移的因果影响。
AI.findings: 1. 目的地房价上涨10%减少迁入4.0%；2. 原籍地房价上涨10%增加迁出2.8%；3. 外国出生和年轻群体对原籍地房价更敏感；4. 租金影响比房价更强；5. 2017-23年高生产率省份房价过快上涨导致约63,000工作年龄人口未能迁入。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供房价影响人口迁移的因果证据；2. 揭示房价作为迁移障碍的具体机制；3. 区分房价和租金的不同影响；4. 分析不同人口群体的异质性反应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 量化房价差异导致的劳动力配置效率损失；2. 为区域住房政策提供依据；3. 揭示房价调控对劳动力流动的重要性；4. 估算潜在GDP增长机会。

title: Household Behavior under Macroprudential Borrower-Based Measures
affiliations: International Monetary Fund (IMF) and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Household Behavior under Macroprudential Borrower-Based Measures

publicationDetails.journalName: International Monetary Fund (IMF) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper develops a life cycle model to study household choice under macroprudential borrower-based measures (BBMs). The model is extended to multiple heterogeneous households, allowing to assess both aggregate and distributional effects of BBMs on mortgage and housing demand. The framework is applied to Lithuanian and Slovak distributional data to quantify the impact of various BBM configurations. We find that the presence of binding BBMs can usefully dampen mortgage and house price growth. However, tight regulation may also redirect demand towards lower-valued housing, while pushing households into the rental market. In particular, loan-to-value (LTV) limits are most constraining for households with little or no initial wealth. This highlights the distributional consequences of BBMs and the importance of designing regulation to account for borrower characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个生命周期模型来研究宏观审慎借款人措施（BBMs）下的家庭选择。通过扩展到多个异质家庭，评估BBMs对抵押贷款和住房需求的总体和分配效应。应用立陶宛和斯洛伐克数据发现，BBMs能抑制抵押贷款和房价增长，但严格监管可能将需求转向低价住房并推动家庭进入租赁市场，LTV限制对初始财富少的家庭影响最大。
AI.research_question: 宏观审慎借款人措施（BBMs）如何影响家庭的抵押贷款和住房需求？这些措施对总体经济和收入分配有什么影响？
AI.motivation: 宏观审慎政策如贷款价值比（LTV）限制被广泛用于稳定房地产市场，但对其分配效应了解有限。需要理解BBMs如何影响不同特征家庭的住房选择，以设计更公平有效的监管政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期模型，扩展到多个异质家庭，考虑家庭财富、收入、住房偏好等异质性特征，分析宏观审慎政策下的家庭最优决策。
AI.method: 建立理论生命周期模型，扩展到多家庭异质框架，应用立陶宛和斯洛伐克的分布数据进行量化分析，评估不同BBMs配置的影响。
AI.findings: 1. BBMs能有效抑制抵押贷款和房价增长；2. 严格监管可能将需求转向低价住房并推动家庭进入租赁市场；3. LTV限制对初始财富少的家庭约束最大；4. BBMs具有显著的分配效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将生命周期模型扩展到多家庭异质框架，能同时分析总体和分配效应；2. 为宏观审慎政策的分配效应分析提供理论框架；3. 揭示BBMs通过影响家庭住房选择渠道的作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供BBMs设计建议，需考虑借款人特征；2. 揭示LTV限制对低收入家庭的特殊影响；3. 提供立陶宛和斯洛伐克的实证证据；4. 建议政策设计需平衡金融稳定和社会公平目标。
